## 481. Spicy Paneer Tikka Wrap!
**@nids.lid** · 2025-02-06 · video · ❤ 28302 · https://www.instagram.com/p/DFuKoPTS4fT/

Spicy Paneer Tikka Wrap!

📝 Ingredients :
Harissa Paste: 
- 8-10 red chilies (soaked in hot water for 10 minutes) 
- 3 garlic cloves 
- 1 tsp jeera (cumin seeds) 
- 1 tsp coriander seeds 
- Salt to taste 
- 1 tbsp olive oil 

Masala Mix: 
- ½ tbsp red chili powder 
- 1 tsp turmeric powder 
- ½ tbsp coriander powder 
- 1 tsp chaat masala or dry mango powder 
- 1 tsp kasuri methi 
- Salt to taste 
- 1 tsp ginger garlic paste 
- 1 tsp garam masala 
- 1 tbsp besan (gram flour) 
- 2 tbsp hot oil 

Paneer Tikka:
- ½ cup yogurt 
- 200g paneer (cubed) 
- Veggies of choice (bell peppers, onions, tomatoes) 

Salad Mix:
- 1 cup thinly sliced cabbage & carrot 
- 1 tbsp mint chutney 
- 1 tbsp lemon juice 

Method :
- Blend soaked chilies, garlic, jeera, coriander seeds, salt, and olive oil into a smooth harissa paste. 
- In a bowl, mix all masala ingredients, pour sizzling hot oil over, and whisk well. 
- Add yogurt, paneer, and veggies, mix well, and marinate. 
- Roast on a pan or grill until slightly charred. 
- Mix cabbage, carrot, mint chutney, and lemon juice for the salad. 
- Spread harissa paste on a roti, layer with salad and paneer tikka, wrap, and enjoy.

సోయా చంక్స్ - 1 కప్పు 
వేడి నీళ్లు 
పెరుగు - 1 / 4 కప్పు 
పసుపు - 1 / 4 టీస్పూన్ 
ఎండుకారం - 1 టీస్పూన్ 
ఉప్పు - 1 / 2 టీస్పూన్

పులావ్ తయారుచేయడానికి కావలసిన పదార్థాలు:

బాస్మతి రైస్ - 1 కప్పు (250 మిల్లీలీటర్లు) 
నెయ్యి - 2 టేబుల్స్పూన్లు 
నూనె - 1 టేబుల్స్పూన్
మసాలా దినుసులు (దాల్చిన చెక్క, లవంగం, యాలక్కాయలు, బిర్యానీ ఆకు & జీలకర్ర)
ఉల్లిపాయలు - 2 (తరిగినవి) 
పచ్చిమిరపకాయలు -  2 (తరిగినవి) 
దంచుకున్న అల్లం వెల్లుల్లి - 1 టీస్పూన్ 
టొమాటోలు - 2 (తరిగినవి) 
పసుపు - 1 / 4 టీస్పూన్
ఎండుకారం - 1 టీస్పూన్ 
గరం మసాలా - 1 టీస్పూన్ 
పుదీనా ఆకులు 
కొత్తిమీర 
ఉప్పు 
నీళ్లు - 1 1 / 2 కప్పులు 

తయారుచేసే విధానం 

ముందుగా సొయా చంక్స్ను వేడి నీళ్ళల్లో పదిహేను నిమిషాల పాటు నానపెట్టాలి

ఇప్పుడొక బౌలులో బియ్యాన్ని ఇరవై నిమిషాల పాటు నానపెట్టాలి

## 488. This jowar porridge makes the most comforting breakfast that is light yet substantial.

This jowar porridge makes the most comforting breakfast that is light yet substantial.

I didn’t grow up with this recipe, Aai came up with it just a few years back when she started incorporating more millets in her diet. This liquidy version isn’t a traditional recipe, but could be thought of as a lighter, easier to digest form of the classic Ukadpendi that combines jowar flour with a basic tempering in a dry, upma-like form. 

Here is Aai’s recipe that you can make either with jowar/ bajra flour.
 
Serves 3

In a deep pot/ kadhai, heat 
1 Tbsp oil, temper it with 
1/4 tsp mustard seeds
1/4 tsp cumin seeds
Heeng
1/4 tsp fennel seeds (saunf)
1/2 a green chilli- Aai has specifically asked me to note that this porridge gets very spicy very quickly, so use just 1/2-1 green chilli 
6-7 curry leaves
2 Tbsp peanuts  (optional- but recommended for texture)

Let the peanuts fry for 1-2 mins, then add
1 small onion, chopped
1/4 tsp turmeric powder

Once the onion softens, add
1/2 a carrot chopped 
1/4 cup of peas (if using frozen peas, add later)

Cover and cook for 3-4 mins. 
While this is cooking, heat ~4 cups of water and keep it ready.

Uncover, then add
Scant 3/4 cup of jowar flour

Roast this well in the tempering till it gets nice and toasty- 3-4 mins.

Then, add the hot water- start with just 1.5 cups, mix thoroughly to break up lumps and then add the rest.

## 497. Let's make super healthy breakfast, this is Horsegram paratha,best for winters.Single paratha gives 329 calories and 15g
**@dietkundali24** · 2025-01-24 · video · ❤ 2338 · https://www.instagram.com/p/DFMtuTOoFKs/

Let's make super healthy breakfast, this is Horsegram paratha,best for winters.Single paratha gives 329 calories and 15gm proteins.

Benefits of Horse gram

1-Aids in Weight Loss

2-Manage Diabetes

3-Prevents Kidney Stones

4-Improves Heart Health

5-Boosts Immunity

6-High in Protein and Fibre

7-Low in calories

8-Rich in Iron

9-Contains essential Minerals

Horse Gram Paratha

Horsegram cutlet
Serving-5-6 cutlets
Ingredients
1. Horse gram-120gm
2. Onion-40gm
3. Carrot-20gm
4. Coriander leaves-handful
5. Chili-as per taste
6. Salt-as per taste
7. Cinnamon stick-1 small stick
8. Bay leaves-1
9. Oil- for greasing tawa

Method

1. Wash and soak the Horse gram for 8 hours.
2. Now add soaked horse gram to pressure cooker, add salt, cinnamon stick, bay leaves, little water and cook until 4-5 whistle came.
3. Now add cooked horse gram to mixer jar add ginger and garlic, grind it, please note don’t add any water to it.
4. Take it out this mixture in a bowl add chopped onion, grated carrot, Dhaniya, chili and salt. Mix well.
5. Give cutlet shape and roast it both sides on tawa.
6. Serve hot with chutney and salad or onion.
7. Take (Whole wheat atta 40gm), knead the dough and roll it, add 2 horsegram cutlet add it and roll it ,
8-Cook both sides add few drops of oil/Ghee.

## 499. Recipe ⬇️ (25g P, 350 Cals)
**@fit.khurana** · 2025-01-23 · video · ❤ 79063 · https://www.instagram.com/p/DFKrzz6RLL6/

Recipe ⬇️ (25g P, 350 Cals)

Ingredients-
For the base:
1 cup soaked yellow moong dal
2 green chillies
2 cloves garlic
Salt to taste
1 Cup Chopped Spinach (Optional)
Seasoning - 1 tsp Kalaunji seeds, 1 tbsp oregano, 1 tbsp mixed herbs, 1/2 tsp pepper

For toppings -
90g low fat paneer (homemade - Comment “paneer” to get the recipe)
1/2 cube cheese
Any veggies of choice
2 tbsp pizza sauce (I use homemade)
Basil leaves

🌸Grind soaked moong, chillies, salt and garlic into a smooth paste along with some water. (The consistency shoulf be that of a dosa batter)

🌸Add chopped spinach and all the seasonings into this batter and mix well

🌸Make a regular cheela (a little thicker) on a non-stick tava and while it is partially cooked add low fat crumbled paneer on top

🌸Using a spatula, press onto the paneer so that it sticks well to the uncooked side of the cheela

🌸Now flip and cook for 3-4 mins until the paneer side is golden

🌸Now add your pizza sauce, veggies, basil and cheese

🌸Cover and cook on low flame for 8-10 mins until the veggies have softened and cheese has melted

🌸Slice and enjoy❤️

✅Need the recipe for my homemade low fat paneer? Comment “paneer” and I will dm you❤️

## 502. Let’s turn chickpeas into tofu!
**@theplantcollective_** · 2025-01-22 · video · ❤ 3 · https://www.instagram.com/p/DFIoXzTpOIB/

Let’s turn chickpeas into tofu!

This is a recipe for BURMESE TOFU aka SHAN TOFU aka CHICKPEA TOFU. I’m in my high protein era right now and I have been loving finding new ways to increase my protein count with plants. I absolutely LOVE soy, but I’m always looking for ways to diversify my diet to keep as healthy a gut as possible.

Turning chickpeas into tofu takes a minute but is really easy.

▪️Soak the chickpeas in water overnight.
▪️Drain and rinse.
▪️Blend with water.
▪️Mix with spices.
▪️Cook until coagualted.
▪️Transfer to a container.
▪️Let sit for at least 24 hours.
▪️Chop into cubes and bake until golden.

	•	1 tsp garam masala

	•	2 tbsp fresh cream
	•	1 tsp kasuri methi (dried fenugreek leaves)
	•	Handful of fresh coriander leaves

Steps to Prepare Masala Paste:

	1.	Heat 3 tbsp oil in a pan. Add 1/2 cup cashews and fry until golden brown. Remove and set aside.
	2.	In the same pan, add halved mushrooms. Sprinkle with salt and 1/2 tsp turmeric powder. Sauté until the moisture evaporates. Remove and set aside.
	3.	In the same pan, add chopped onions and sauté until golden. Add ginger-garlic paste and cook until fragrant.
	4.	Add the ground masala paste and cook until the oil releases from the sides of the pan.
	5.	Season with salt, 1/2 tsp turmeric powder, Kashmiri chili powder, coriander powder, and garam masala. Mix well.

## 507. HIGH PROTEIN SOYA CHILLI
**@cook.with.karish** · 2025-01-21 · video · ❤ 130830 · https://www.instagram.com/p/DFF-ddiotSs/

HIGH PROTEIN SOYA CHILLI

Per serving: 44g protein, 429 cals, 47g carbs, 2.4g fat

Ingredients:
80g soya chunks @fudcouki brand
2 tbsp corn flour
1/4 tsp each of the following: salt, pepper, paprika
Oil spray
1 tbsp ginger garlic paste
1/2 red onion, finely diced
1/2 bell pepper, finely diced 
Sauce: 1 tbsp ketchup, 2 tbsp dark soya sauce, 1 tbsp sriracha sauce, 1 tsp corn flour, 3 tbsp water
Spring onions, finely sliced

Method:
1. Soak soya chunks in boiling water for 10mins
2. Drain soya chunks and gently squeeze out the excess water
3. Coat them with corn flour, salt, pepper and paprika and dry fry for about 15mins until crispy on all sides, set aside
4. Make the sauce using the ingredients listed above, set aside 
5. In a pan add some oil spray, ginger garlic paste and the chopped onion and bell peppers. Once the veg has cooked add the crispy soya chunks and the sauce
6. Mix well, add the spring onions
7. Enjoy!

## 525. Stuffed Pizza Pitas 🍕🫶
**@butter.street** · 2025-01-15 · video · ❤ 10411 · https://www.instagram.com/p/DE2ki0avwbJ/

Stuffed Pizza Pitas 🍕🫶

Ingredients-

Pita dough-
3 cups all-purpose flour/ maida
3/4 cup warm water
¼ cup warm milk
1 1/2 tsp sugar
1 1/2 tsp active dry yeast
2 tbsp oil
1 1/2 tsp salt

Fillings-
Pizza sauce
Mozzarella cheese 
Grilled mushrooms 
@snapinindia seasonings
Fresh basil

Method-
1. In a medium bowl, mix warm water and milk. Add sugar, then whisk in the yeast. Let sit for 5 minutes until frothy.
2. Stir in olive oil and salt. Gradually mix in flour with a wooden spoon until a dough forms.
3. Knead the dough on a floured surface for 10 minutes until smooth and elastic.
4. Place the dough in a bowl, cover with a lid, and let it rise in a warm spot for 1 hour.
5. Once risen, divide the dough into 6 equal pieces on a floured surface. Flatten each piece. Add fillings of choice (pizza sauce, mozzarella, grilled mushrooms, @snapinindia seasonings, fresh basil) Shape each into a circle and place on a parchment-lined baking sheet. Cover with a towel and let rest for 15 minutes.
6. Roll each piece into a 5-inch circle.
7. Heat a skillet over medium heat, Drizzle a tsp olive oil and cook pitas for 3-4 minutes, flipping every minute until golden brown and puffed. Enjoi hot! 🥵

## 527. Reposting Sambar Powder recipe in English for my non Kannada speaking Followers ❤️
**@suman.ranganath.gowda** · 2025-01-14 · video · ❤ 17639 · https://www.instagram.com/p/DEzFJwzMVb0/

Reposting Sambar Powder recipe in English for my non Kannada speaking Followers ❤️

Recipe : 

🌸 Take 1 cup of dry red chilies ( half byadagi, half Guntur ) and roast them on a low flame for about 5 minutes.
🌸 Set them aside to cool.
🌸 roast 1 cup coriander seeds (dhaniya)
🌸 1/4 cup chana dal (Bengal gram)
🌸 1/4 cup toor dal (pigeon pea)
🌸 1 spoon cumin seeds (jeera)
🌸 2 spoons fenugreek seeds (methi)
🌸 1 spoon black pepper (kali mirch)
🌸 Roast all these ingredients on a low flame for 5-7 minutes.
🌸 Tip: Keep the flame low. High heat can burn the spices or cause them to lose their natural oils, which are essential for flavor.
🌸 Allow the roasted spices to cool for a bit.
🌸 Once cooled, grind all the roasted ingredients in a mixer grinder.
🌸 While grinding, add 1 spoon turmeric powder (arishina) for color and flavor.
🌸 Grind everything into a fine powder.
🌸 Store the prepared sambar powder in an airtight container.
🌸 It stays fresh and flavorful for up to 6 months.

PS: adding Urad dal is optional, why we do not add Urad dal to the sambar powder is because it ferments the sambar in 4-5 hours if we keep it outside after cooking.

Let’s make No rice , gluten free, horsegram dosa.A single dosa gives 123 calories and 5.5gm proteins.This is best alternative of regular rice dosa.Dosa is combination of pulse and rice, but in this recipe instead of urad dal, I am using horse gram and chana dal and instead of rice, I am using millets.This is super crispy and easy to prepare.Best recipe for breakfast to.

Benefits of horse gram

9-Prevents Kidney stone

Horse Gram Dosa

Serving-12-14 dosa

Ingredients

1-Horse gram -100gm(1/2 cup)

2-Chana dal-50gm(1/4th cup)

3-Barnayad millet-250gm(1cup and 1/4th cup)

4-Methi dana-1 tsp

5-Salt- as per taste

6-Poha-15gm(1/2 cup)

Method

1-Wash and soak horse gram, chana dal, millets and methi dana for 6-8 hours.

2-Add it in mixer jar add wash and 30 min soaked poha to it.

3-Grind it as fine paste.

4-Mix well with washed hands, cover it and keep it kitchen counter overnight for fermentation.

5-next morning add some salt and water and mix well.

6-Heat the cast iron pan, pour the spoon full ladder and make dosa.

7-you can add few drops of oil top of the dosa.

8-Cook both sides in low to medium flame.

9-Super healthy horse gram dosa is ready to serve.

Healthy bhajia/mangodi 😁 🌿gluten-free 🌿vegan

If I share any air fried recipe here,  doesn’t mean that I’m against deep frying. I enjoy deep-fried stuff on festivals or when traveling but can’t do it regularly, that’s all! This one satisfies my bhajia cravings and in such a nutritious way!

INGREDIENTS :
🌿1 cup green moong - washed and soaked for 4-5 hours or overnight. Then, strain the water 
🌿1/2 inch ginger, 4 garlic cloves, and 1 green chili chopped 
Make a course paste with the above ingredients and then add 
🌿1/2 cup finely chopped green garlic 
🌿1/2 cup finely chopped onion
🌿1 cup finely chopped cabbage 
🌿1 cup chopped spinach
🌿1/2 tsp ajwain
🌿1/2 tsp heeng
🌿1 tsp turmeric
🌿1 tbsp sesame seeds
🌿2 tbsp rice flour ( for making them crispy)
🌿1/4 cup besan 
🌿salt to taste
🌿baking soda 1/4 tsp

Preheat airfryer for 5 minutes @180C, then put small small bhajias in basket like you would do in a kadhai(while deep frying). Your basket should be brushed with little oil. Airfry for 10 minutes @180C tossing midway and brushing a bit of oil. 

Tip: Your batter should be thick and not runny, so make sure to NOT add any water and strain the moong dal nicely before making paste. Use a chopper to chop veggies fine

## 553. EASY: Palak Rice For Lunch 🔥
**@hungrymahi** · 2025-01-03 · video · ❤ 17954 · https://www.instagram.com/p/DEXYqn0p3Z4/

EASY: Palak Rice For Lunch 🔥

Ingredients 
Spinach 
Garlic 
Green chillie 
Panner cubed really small
Cumin seeds
Garlic powder 
Onion powder
Salt
Soy sauce

Steps:

First blanch the spinach in boiling water for 2-3 minutes. Remove and dip it in cold water. Strain and remove excess water.  Leave it aside.

Add set aside spinach along with garlic and green chillies and blend into a smooth paste.

In a wok add oil followed by cumin seeds. Let it splutter. Add cubed panner and sauté for 1-2 minutes. Then add the palak paste and cook it till raw taste goes away. If you want you can lightly season it with salt.

Finally add cooked basmati rice along with garlic powder, oinion powder, salt & soy sauce. Give it a good mix and our palak rice is ready.

Make sure that you are not using  hot rice. Cook the rice beforehand leave it aside till it cools down completely or you can use leftover rice from the previous day.

Serve it with pickle &  raita 👌🏼

## 558. Air Fryer Cauliflower Tikka 
**@mumbaifoodiz** · 2025-01-02 · video · ❤ 7395 · https://www.instagram.com/p/DEUuBfYPt4D/

Air Fryer Cauliflower Tikka 

✨ Tasty & healthy low-calorie Gobi Tikka snack that’s perfect for guilt-free indulgence!
Ingredients

🌸 1 small cauliflower (cut into florets)
🥛 1/2 cup curd (yogurt)
🌾 2 tbsp gram flour (besan)
🛢️ 2 tbsp oil (mustard oil preferred)
🍋 1 tbsp lemon juice
🧄 1 tsp ginger-garlic paste
🌶️ 1 tsp red chili powder
🍢 1 tsp tandoori masala
🌟 1/2 tsp turmeric powder
🌿 1/2 tsp kasuri methi (dried fenugreek leaves)
🧂 Salt to taste
🌱 Fresh coriander for garnish
Method
	1.	Mix curd, gram flour, oil, lemon juice, ginger-garlic paste, and spices in a bowl.
	2.	Coat cauliflower florets in the marinade; rest for 15 minutes.
	3.	Air fry at 180°C for 15 minutes until crispy.
	4.	Garnish with coriander and serve hot!

Recipe

Add tamarind extract (a small sized tamarind soaked and extracted)

Salt to taste
Add 1 cup water
Bring it to boil

Pepper - 1 tsp

## 563. 🍕 Homemade Chickpea Pizza 🍕- New Year Special🤩🥂
**@fitelo_tamil** · 2025-01-01 · video · ❤ 10108 · https://www.instagram.com/p/DERa1pryOrY/

🍕 Homemade Chickpea Pizza 🍕- New Year Special🤩🥂

🍽️ Ingredients:
	•	Chickpeas (soaked overnight) – 1 cup
	•	Water – As needed
	•	Salt – To taste
	•	Homemade tomato sauce (see preparation)
	•	Cheese – As desired
	•	Onion – 1 (sliced)
	•	Tomatoes – 1 (sliced)
	•	Green chilies – 1-2 (chopped)
	•	Oregano – For taste
	•	Chili flakes – Optional

🍅Tomato Sauce Preparation:
	1.	Heat ½ tbsp olive oil in a pan.
	2.	Sauté 1 chopped garlic clove until fragrant.
	3.	Add 1 grated tomato and 2 tbsp tomato paste.
	4.	Sprinkle black pepper and oregano.
	5.	Cook until the sauce thickens.

🫓Chickpea Base Preparation:
	1.	Grind soaked chickpeas with salt and minimal water into a thick paste.
	2.	Spread on a hot tawa and cook on both sides like roti.

🍕Pizza Assembly:
	1.	Place the cooked chickpea base in a pan on medium flame.
	2.	Spread the prepared tomato sauce evenly.
	3.	Add cheese, onion, tomatoes, green chilies, oregano, and chili flakes on top.
	4.	Cover and cook on low flame for 5-10 minutes until the cheese melts.
	5.	Serve hot and enjoy!!♥️🥂

My back is burned and I can’t create content so here’s an old recipe  to help you keep on track in the new year 💃 u can eat this pizza everyday 😜 

High protein lentil pizza recipe 🍕

Ingredients 
- 1 cup red lentils 
- 3-4 cloves garlic 
- 1/2 tsp baking powder
- Red pepper flakes 
- Salt to taste 
- Pizza sauce 
- Grated mozzarella cheese 

Method 
- soak 1 cup red lentils overnight 
- Drain lentils and add to a blender with chili flakes, salt, baking powder & red pepper flakes
- Blend till the consistency is smooth. You also may need to add around 1/4 - 1/2 cup of water to reach desired consistency 
- Once you’ve reached desired consistency, spread evenly on a baking tray (try to make it as thin as possible, or the texture will be chewy) 
- Bake in oven for 30-40 mins or until golden 
- Add pizza sauce & cheese and bake again until cheese is melted

## 570. Flaky, flavorful, and packed with a perfect blend of spices – Matar Paneer Paratha to warm your soul! #HomemadeGoodness 
**@plate_it_with_shyama_thanvi** · 2024-12-27 · video · ❤ 145 · https://www.instagram.com/p/DEFI6e-yOGl/

Flaky, flavorful, and packed with a perfect blend of spices – Matar Paneer Paratha to warm your soul! #HomemadeGoodness #ParathaLove”

Recipe:

Ingredients:

1 cup crushed matar (green peas)
1/2 cup grated paneer
1 small onion, finely chopped
1 tsp red chili powder
1 tsp chili flakes
1/2 tsp hing (asafoetida)
1 tsp saunf (fennel seeds)
Salt to taste
Whole wheat flour (for dough)
Water (for kneading)
Ghee or oil (for cooking)
Instructions:

In a bowl, mix the crushed matar, grated paneer, chopped onion, red chili powder, chili flakes, hing, saunf, and salt. Set aside.

Prepare the dough by kneading whole wheat flour with a pinch of salt and water until soft and smooth.
Divide the dough into small balls, and roll each ball into a small circle.

Place a spoonful of the filling mixture in the center of the rolled dough.
Carefully seal the edges and roll it out gently into a flat paratha.

Heat a tawa or griddle. Cook the paratha on both sides, applying ghee or oil, until golden and crispy.
Serve hot with yogurt or pickle.

## 592. Thecha paneer Recipe👇
**@shraddhapalande** · 2024-12-12 · video · ❤ 178225 · https://www.instagram.com/p/DDenfeaIeXN/

Thecha paneer Recipe👇

• In a pan add oil & fry paneer on both sides.

• In the same pan add oil in that add 2 tbsp cumin seeds, lots of garlic,green chillies, sesame seeds, dry coconut and fresh coriander ,cook it for 2-3 minutes.

• Transfer this mixture in a mixer grinder and make a fine paste

• Now in a pan add 1 thinly sliced onion,cook it until it gets translucent and add the paste

• Cook for 1-2 minutes and add some water, mix it well 

• Add turmeric, coriander pwd & salt.

• Cover and cook it for another 3-4 minutes.

• Now add fried paneer, fresh green chillies.

• Add garam masala and garnish with fresh coriander.

* कढईत थोडे तेल घालून दोन्ही बाजूंनी पनीर तळून घ्या.
* त्याच कढईत थोडे तेल घालून त्यात २ चमचे जिरे, भरपूर लसूण, हिरवी मिरची, तीळ, सुके खोबरे आणि कोथिंबीर घालून २-३ मिनिटे शिजवा.
* हे मिश्रण मिक्सर ग्राइंडरमध्ये फिरवून त्याची बारीक पेस्ट बनवा
* आता एका कढईत १ बारीक चिरलेला कांदा घाला, ट्रान्सपरंट होईपर्यंत शिजवा आणि तयार पेस्ट घाला
* १-२ मिनिटे शिजवा आणि थोडे पाणी घाला, चांगले मिसळा
* थोडी हळद, धणे पावडर आणि मीठ घाला.
* झाकण ठेवून आणखी ३-४ मिनिटे शिजवा.
* आता तळलेले पनीर, हिरवी मिरची घाला.
* थोडा गरम मसाला घालून कोथिंबिरीने सजवा.

-Chopped onion

-chopped tomato 
-corn 
-fresh coriander 
-small cubes of paneer 
-pepper powder

## 623. Roasted veggies pasta made in 20 minutes ❤️
**@the.margherita.diet** · 2024-11-29 · video · ❤ 13642 · https://www.instagram.com/p/DC87qOATDtC/

Roasted veggies pasta made in 20 minutes ❤️

STEPS-

PASTA PREP
- 2 cups pasta 
- 1 litre water 
- 1 tsp oil
- 1 tsp salt
Boil the water and then add salt, oil, pasta in boiling water. Cook until pasta is cooked on a medium flame. Drain (save the pasta water for later) rinse and keep aside. You can also toss it in some more oil to avoid sticking. 

SAUCE PREP
- 1 red bell pepper
- 2 tomatoes 
- 1 onion 
- 8-10 garlic cloves 
- 2 soaked bydagi red chillies (optional)
- Salt & Pepper to taste
- 1 tbsp oil

Roughly chop the vegetables and mix with the rest of the ingredients. Grill in a microwave for 15-20 minutes, or do the same in an air fryer or on a pan. Once the veggies are charred and aromatic, cool them down. Blend until smooth. 

FINAL STAGE
- Heat a pan and add the pasta sauce. 
- Cook this for 5-7 minutes, and add pasta water as per consistency desired.
- Keep stirring and add chopped coriander and 1-2 tbsp fresh cream (optional)
- Add salt, oregano to taste and toss in the boiled pasta.
- Serve hot, garnish with basil, coriander or chilli oil!

## 626. This mushroom soup is comforting and perfect for your dinner. 
**@thevegetarianladki** · 2024-11-29 · video · ❤ 4743 · https://www.instagram.com/p/DC8qWMhyUWh/

This mushroom soup is comforting and perfect for your dinner. 

Recipe: 

1. 2 packets of Mushroom ( 15-17 pieces) 
2. 1 tsp ghee 
3. 1 cup spinach 
4. 1-1.5 glasses of water 
5. Salt to taste 
6. Black pepper 
7. Chaat masala 
8. 1 cup fresh cream 

Recipe: 

☘️ saute mushrooms in a tsp of ghee for 5-7 minutes until it releases water. 

Tip: Don’t dry all of the water that mushroom releases. 

☘️ Add half of the mushrooms in a grinder jaar with 1/2 cup of water in it. 

☘️ Put this grinded paste into the pan with 1-1.5 glasses of water. 

☘️ Add spinach, fresh cream and the masalas mentioned above. Cook it for another 5-7 minutes until it forms into a creamier texture and its readyy!!

## 631. Rajasthani Lehsun Lal Mirch Ki Chutney ❤️ Recipe ⬇️ 
**@cookwithshivangi_** · 2024-11-27 · video · ❤ 108001 · https://www.instagram.com/p/DC4BpD5ShEL/

Rajasthani Lehsun Lal Mirch Ki Chutney ❤️ Recipe ⬇️ 
📌Soak Kashmiri red chillies in buttermilk for 2-3 hours 
📌 In a mortar and pestle pound the soaked chillies with some jeera, salt and dhaniya (or mint) 
📌 Add garlic pods and pound again. If the chutney seems dry keep adding the buttermilk while pounding 
📌 Prepare a tadka of ghee (or oil) and add jeera, mustard and saunf followed by chopped garlic and then add the prepared chutney 
📌Mix it for a few minutes and enjoy with bhakris, rotis, dal baati or anything you like. I have used it a spread for aloo sandwich and it tastes so good 🙈

Paneer Tikka sandwich🥪

Ingredients:

* 200g paneer, cubed
* 1/2 cup hung curd
* 1/2 tbsp mustard oil
* 1 tsp each: coriander powder, red chili powder, Kitchen King masala, salt
* 1 tbsp Ginger garlic paste 
* 1-2 green chili 
* Bread slices 
* Butter 

Instructions:

* Mix hung curd with mustard oil, spices, and ginger-garlic-green chili paste. Coat paneer cubes and marinate for 20-25 minutes.

* Air fry at 180°C for 8-10 minutes “OR” Cook on a pan “OR” Roast on skewers over an open flame.

* Toast bread slices in butter, layer with paneer tikka, serve hot mint chutney and enjoii🫂

## 637. No Bread, Bread Roll 
**@mrsyumtum** · 2024-11-25 · video · ❤ 1681 · https://www.instagram.com/p/DCydc7lSsW4/

No Bread, Bread Roll 
(Makes 4-5)

Bread roll is a dish who doesn’t like and reminds us of childhood times. Now that we have all become conscious we tend to avoid it & bread soaks in a lot of oil. With this recipe you can enjoy similar taste but a healthier version. 

Upma: ( the bread in the recipe) 
-Take 1 packet of gladfuls Sprouted Millet ghee upma.
-Take double water & let it come to a boil. 
-Add 1/2tsp turmeric powder & 1/2tsp red chilli powder. 
-Add the upma & mix well. Cover & cook for 3-4min. 
-Mix it & cover again. Cook till all the water evaporates. 
-Let it cool completely. 

Potato Stuffing: 
-Take 2 boiled potatoes. 
-Add chopped onions
-fresh coriander leaves
-1/2tsp chilli powder 
-1/2tsp roasted cumin powder 
-1/2tsp coriander powder 
-1/2tsp chaat masala 
-salt to taste 

Making the bread roll: 
-Grease your hands with some oil. Take a small portion of the upma. Flatten it in your palms. 
-Place the will stuffing in it. And cover the potatoes stuffing with upma gently giving it a shape of a bread roll. As shown in the video. 
-Cook it in a pan with some oil. Flip & cook from all sides till golden brown crisp. 
-Enjoy with some ketchup or green chutney.

Forgot to soak chhole or rajma overnight? 😰 Don’t worry, we’ve got you covered with this quick and easy kitchen hack! ⏱️ 

All you need is a casserole and some hot water. 💡 Add the chhole to the casserole, pour in boiling hot water and cover it with a lid. Let it sit for just 1 hour and voilà— chhole is fully soaked and ready to cook! 🍛 

No more last-minute panic or changing your meal plans. 🙌 This hack saves you time and ensures your favourite dish like chhole bhature is always on the menu, even if you forget to soak it overnight.

Easy Pepper Rasam with Garlic is a natural remedy to make you feel better for common cold and cough. 

Pepper Garlic Rasam is one of the easiest, quickest and healthy rasam out of all the Rasam. It can be made within 15 minutes and a very flavourful one. During cold, pepper and garlic helps you to feel relieved. You can enjoy even having as a hot soup!  I always make this now and then. 

Garlic is known for it’s natural antibiotic property. So Using it along with black pepper freshly not only is refreshing but also serves as remedy.

Ingredients:
Black Pepper, 1 Tbsp
Cumin Seeds, 1/2 Tbsp
Curry Leaves, 2 Sprigs
Garlic, 3 cloves
Puréed Tomatoes, 3
Tamarind Water, 300ml
Salt to taste
Turmeric, 1 Tsp
Coriander to garnish

Instructions: 
* Soak tamarind and extract the tamarind juice, keep aside. 
* On a tawa, dry roast jeera, black pepper and curry leaves. 
* Transfer them to a silbatta/mixer grinder, and pound coarsely. Add garlic and pound again. 
* Add Tomato puree in a kadai followed by tamarind extract, salt, haldi and bring to boil.
* Add the crushed pepper and garlic. mix well and switch off (don’t let boil)
* Garnish with coriander.

Ingredients:

For Dough:
2 cups semolina (powdered)
Salt (to taste)
1 tsp oil
Water (to make dough)

For Marination:
2 tbsp mustard oil
1 tsp turmeric powder
1 tsp red chili powder
1 tsp coriander powder
1 tsp black pepper powder
1 tsp garam masala
1 tsp cumin powder
A pinch of asafoetida (hing)
Kasuri methi (dried fenugreek leaves)
Salt (to taste)
1 tsp ginger-garlic paste

Veggies: Paneer, onion, capsicum

Paneer tikka (prepared)

Amla dal is just toor dal, but with the added goodness of amla. It is brimming with several health benefits and is a must-try for the winter season.

Amlas are an excellent source of Vitamin C and antioxidants, which are essential for our body functions. 
Consuming amlas can help you control diabetes and improve your digestion, eyesight, immunity, memory, and brain health.

Toor or Arhar dal is a great choice for vegetarians and vegans as it is an excellent source of plant-based protein. This dal also contains dietary fibres, which help maintain a happy digestive system and weight.

Ingredients: 
* ¾ cup Toor Dal
* 5-6 washed Amlas (Indian gooseberries)
* 1 pc raw turmeric
* 2 cups water
* Salt (as per taste)
* 1 onion, finely chopped
* 1 green chilli
* 1 teaspoon cumin seeds
* ¼ teaspoon of hing
* 2 Tomatoes, grated
* 1 tablespoon red chilli powder
* 1 teaspoon coriander powder
* ¼ teaspoon Garam Masala
* Desi Ghee

Instructions:
1. Wash and soak toor dal for at least 30 minutes.
2. Pressure cook for 3 whistles, along with amlas, turmeric, water and salt. 
3. Take out the mushy amlas and turmeric on a plate and deseed them. Blend into purée and keep aside.
4. For tempering, take a small pan and add ghee. After it heats up, add cumin seeds and wait for them to splutter, add hing, onions, sauté for 5 minut …

## 649. Aapko Palak ka kya pasand hai?😉❤️😃
**@poonamscookery_** · 2024-11-19 · video · ❤ 21461 · https://www.instagram.com/p/DCjdv_8PtGb/

Aapko Palak ka kya pasand hai?😉❤️😃

Spinach Paratha Recipe

Ingredients:

Spinach (a bundle, washed and finely chopped)
Wheat flour – 2 cups
Besan (gram flour) – 2 teaspoons
Onion – 1 medium, finely chopped
Garlic – 2-3 cloves, minced
Ginger – 1 inch, grated
Green chilli – 1-2, finely chopped
Turmeric powder – 1/2 teaspoon
Red chilli powder – 1/2 teaspoon
Garam masala – 1/2 teaspoon
Carom seeds (ajwain) – 1/2 teaspoon
Black seeds (kalonji) – 1/2 teaspoon
Salt – to taste
Oil – 1 Tsp
Coriander leaves 
Ghee or oil – for cooking

Procedure:
Wash and chop spinach. Mix it with wheat flour, besan, onion, garlic, ginger, green chilli, coriander leaves, and spices (turmeric, red chilli, garam masala, carom seeds, black seeds, and salt). Add water to knead a tight dough. Divide into portions, roll into parathas, and cook on a hot tawa with ghee or oil. Serve hot with sabzi or tomato chutney.

## 651. This high protein soy burger(it has  50 grams of protein) is the stuff you want to put in your mouth again and again, no
**@beersforbreakie** · 2024-11-18 · video · ❤ 69584 · https://www.instagram.com/p/DCgv-P2yLX0/

This high protein soy burger(it has  50 grams of protein) is the stuff you want to put in your mouth again and again, not the freaky way you think rascal. It’s cheap, easy to make, doesn’t need too many dishes. The sauce is very simple here to keep it realistic but tbh when I make burgers for me I only use ketchup leftover from takeout, you do you - go crazy I say. 

Ingredients:
Soya chunks - 100gms after reconstituted in water
Green chillies- 4
Saunf/perunseeragam - one teaspoon 
Salt to taste
Oil - just a splash
Chilli powder - a splash of
Garlic - three cloves
Maida - three tablespoons 

Procedure:
Reconstitute the soya chunks in warm water. After ten minutes, squeeze the water of them and into a mixer jar it goes. Add the green chillies and saunf/perunseeragam, blend until well shredded now add a splash of water and maida to combine them well, besan flour also works. In a hot pan add a splash of oil and in goes the soya mixture, form round patties as thin as possible. Cover and cook for seven minutes each side in medium heat. Flip and press it down to get the other side also charred. Now it’s a matter of assembly. I used tomatoes, onion and cucumber because that’s what I had lying around. For the sauce, combine some mayo, ketchup(optional- minced garlic, hot sauce and lil of herbs). Now it’s time to serve and eat!

## 652. Recipe⬇️
**@fit.khurana** · 2024-11-18 · video · ❤ 68153 · https://www.instagram.com/p/DCgtqoQOn24/

Recipe⬇️

Macros - 2 Rotis - 225 Cals, 25g Protein

Ingredients (Makes 2-3 rotis):
✅150g soft low fat paneer (homemade) (Comment “paneer” for the recipe to get it in your dms)
✅3-4 tbsp of whole wheat flour

1. Crush/grate paneer and add 2 tbsp flour. Start kneading the dough and then add 1-2 tbsp of flour again.
2. It will take you 6-7 mins to make the dough soft and well combined. Absolutely no water is required to knead this dough as homemade paneer reatins a little water.
3. Divide the dough into equal balls and start rolling into rotis.
4. Cook them like normal rotis on a tawa and cook on low flame. 
5. Apply some ghee on your rotis once off the flame and enjoy with sabzis/curries

MOST IMPORTANT TIP - Apply oil on your rolling board so that this roti does not tear apart while rolling.

## 655. Pesarattu premix
**@traditionallymodernfood** · 2024-11-16 · video · ❤ 1066 · https://www.instagram.com/p/DCa8fnWxZoi/

Pesarattu premix
Ingredients
2 cups Whole moong dal/ green gram/moong bean
1/4 cup Raw rice
3 Green chillies
1 tablespoon Ginger
Curry leaves
1 teaspoon cumin seeds
Asafoetida
Salt
Pesarattu dosa
Water
Oil
Onion
Coriander
Instructions
🌟wash moong bean and raw rice
🌟Drain the water in a colander
🌟Spread in a cloth and drain the water completely
🌟Dry roast green chilli, ginger and curry leaves
🌟 add cumin seeds; saute for 30 seconds and transfer
🌟Dry roast moong bean and rice and turn off the stove
🌟 add other roasted ingredients and turn off the stove
🌟Add salt and Asafoetida; cool and grind into a fine powder
Pesarattu dosai
🌟Mix premix and water; rest for 10 minutes
🌟Heat dosa pan on medium heat and once the pan is hot, sprinkle a little water and add 2 ladles of Pesarattu batter and make Pesarattu dosa
🌟After the pesarattu is half cooked sprinkle onion and coriander leaves and drizzle oil
🌟Cook pesarattu and serve hot

## 660. ✨Ragi should definitely be a part of your daily meal and it’s also very easy to make ragi porridge / milk. 
**@consciouslivingwithshalini** · 2024-11-15 · video · ❤ 1721 · https://www.instagram.com/p/DCY18spNSPU/

✨Ragi should definitely be a part of your daily meal and it’s also very easy to make ragi porridge / milk. 

✨ Recipe - Mix 2 tbsp of Ragi powder in a 250 ml of water & stir well untill no lumps (Remember the water has to be at room temperature, ragi powder can’t be mixed with hot or warm water. This will leads to lumps that’s can’t be dissolve) 

✨ On a medium flame keep stirring this mixture for 3 to 5 minutes, it will turn into porridge consistency. You can add little bit of milk to this porridge for better taste & to adjust the consistency. You can either add your preferred sweetener - sugar / jaggery or salt & relish it hot . 

✨ This can be your replacement to milk / caffeine. Best time to have it in the mid morning or evening snack time.

## 662. Bihari Besan Curry that I lovingly called Besan Barfi ki Sabji ❤️ This is not some invention by my Bua, it’s infact a tr
**@cookwithshivangi_** · 2024-11-14 · video · ❤ 4712 · https://www.instagram.com/p/DCWnjuYyW-e/

Bihari Besan Curry that I lovingly called Besan Barfi ki Sabji ❤️ This is not some invention by my Bua, it’s infact a traditional Bihari preparation that’s probably called “Khadera” in some parts but since she always prepared it for me I always attribute this dish as my Bua’s curry and she is no more with us so it’s kind of my way of remembering her. Anyway so here’s the detailed recipe: 
📌 Take besan (one cup), add ajwain, ginger garlic paste (optional), salt and Haldi and add three times the water and make a runny batter 
📌 Add it to a greased Kadhai and keep stirring continuously 
📌When it achieves a sheera like consistency transfer it to a greased plate and let it set for a few minutes and cut into any shape you prefer
📌 Pan fry them until they turned crisp and golden 
📌 In a Kadhai add mustard oil and add methi, dry red chilli, tej patta and hing for tempering 
📌 Add onion paste and fry well followed by chopped tomatoes and let it turn mushy 
📌 Add salt turmeric and chilly powder 
📌 Grind mustard seeds, garlic, whole coriander, black pepper, jeera and green chillies and add it to the Kadhai and fry for just a couple minutes. If you over do it the curry will turn bittter 
📌 Add water and let it come to boil
📌 Dunk fried besan barfis and cook for a few minutes 
📌 Add garam masala and garnish with dhaniya ❤️

## 674. Chilli Garlic Cheese Paratha 
**@mrsyumtum** · 2024-11-11 · video · ❤ 1519 · https://www.instagram.com/p/DCOYfkJS-_z/

Chilli Garlic Cheese Paratha 
(Makes 3)

This paratha is a dream for chilli garlic cheese lovers. Just make sure to follow the right proportions mentioned below to the the flavour of chilli garlic right. 

Method: 

Chilli Garlic Paste:
-soak 4-5 Kashmiri dry red chilli for 20min. 
-3-4 garlic cloves
-1tsp salt 
-blend to a paste 

Cheese filling 
-1 small cube grated cheese
-1/4tsp pepper powder
-1/4tsp cumin powder 
-1/4tsp coriander powder 
-fresh coriander leaves 

Method: 
-Add the paste to 1cup whole wheat flour & knead the dough. Cover & rest for 5-10min. 
-Roll out a roti, stuff it & roll again as shown in the video. 
-Cook on both sides till it’s golden & crispy 
-Enjoy with curd or pickle.

Healthy Makhana Pizza 

You just can’t miss this nutritious, healthy wholesome and tasty Makhana pizza recipe, that is perfect for kids lunch box and your weight loss journey too😋😍

📌 Save & Share the recipe!
Follow @thehealthyrasoi for more

Ingredients;- For the batter:
1 cup Makhana/ foxnuts
1 cup sooji
1/2 cup poha
1/2 cup curd
1/2 tsp salt
Water as required (blend everything into a thick batter)
🍕Toppings:
1/2 cup pizza sauce
Grated mozzarella cheese as needed
Red and green bell peppers & onion slices
Some paneer cubes
Dried oregano 
Red chili flakes

Heat a pan on a medium flame, spread some oil then pour some batter. Spread it like chilla (Thickness should be like aloo paratha). Now drizzle some oil and let it cook on low heat till it gets golden brown. Now flip it then spread pizza sauce, cheese, veggies, some paneer cubes and cheese again. Cover and cook on medium low heat till cheese melts. Sprinkle some red chili flakes and oregano. Serve hot & Enjoy!

Mushroom methi chaman😍

This is so flavorful, earthy dish that combines the savoury richness of mushrooms with the mildly bitter and aromatic methi leaves, cooked in a spiced gravy. It’s a must-try dish and goes well with roti, naan and phulka. 

Don’t forget to try this and save it for later. 

👉Ingredients:
-  400g sliced Mushrooms
- 2 large bunches of fenugreek leaves
- 1/2 cup cashews and melon seeds paste
- 5 tbsp oil
- 1 large chopped onion
- 3 green chillies
- 1 tsp of kasuri methi
- 1 tsp of turmeric powder
- Salt as per taste
- 1 tsp of cumin seeds
- 3 cardamom pods
- 4 cloves
- 1 piece of cinnamon
- 2 large finely chopped tomatoes
- 1 tbsp of ginger garlic paste
- 2 tbsp of fresh cream
- 1 tbsp coriander powder 
- Handful of coriander leaves

👉Preparation:

Soak 20 cashews and 2 tbsp of melon seeds for 30 minutes. Grind into fine paste and keep aside.

Heat 2 tbsp of oil and sauté mushrooms in it until they are cooked properly. Add salt and turmeric powder in between.

Heat 3 tbsp of oil and add cinnamon, cloves, cardamom and cumin seeds. Add chopped onion and fry until translucent. Add ginger garlic paste and fry until the raw smell goes away. Add chopped tomatoes, salt, turmeric powder, chilli powder. Cook until tomatoes are mushy. Add methi leaves and saute for 5 minutes on medium heat. Add cashews paste and cook until it releases oil. 5. 1 tsp chana dal

## 704. Paneer Makhani Pasta Skewers
**@mrsyumtum** · 2024-10-28 · video · ❤ 7768 · https://www.instagram.com/p/DBqc85kSfWb/

Paneer Makhani Pasta Skewers
(Makes 8-9 )

These pasta skewers are a fun to have pasta. You don’t have to do much just prep everything before hand, assemble & baker before serving. 

Makhani sauce: 
-In a pan, add some oil & 1tsp cumin.
-Add 1 small onion roughly chopped, 1 small of ginger, 2-3 garlic cloves, 1 large tomato chopped, some coriander stems & 5-6 cashews. 
-Add 1/2tsp turmeric powder & salt. 
-Cover & cook till tomatoes are mushy. 
-Once cool, blend to a fine paste. 

Prepping the pasta:
-I have used @bambinopastafoods nutraawell premium penne pasta here. 
-Boil the pasta till it’s 90% done. 
-Drain excess water & drizzle some oil. Keep aside. 

Paneer Masala: 
-Take smalll cubes of paneer. 
-1/2tsp turmeric powder, 1/2tsp red chilli powder, 1/2tsp magic masala & salt to taste. 
-Mix well & cook in a pan till golden brown. 

Assemble: 
-Put around 9-10 penne pasta in a skewer. 
-Pour generously the makhani sauce
-Add toppings of your choice. 
-Add mozzarella cheese. 
-Bake @ 180 for 6-7min or airfry.

## 705. Diwali chivda made easy in the air fryer✨🪔 Whip up this quick, delicious snack today, it’s perfect for the festive seas
**@twinsbymyside** · 2024-10-27 · video · ❤ 3 · https://www.instagram.com/p/DBohgwqpiuh/

Diwali chivda made easy in the air fryer✨🪔 Whip up this quick, delicious snack today, it’s perfect for the festive season. 
Enjoy the crunch and thank me later🥰

Ingredients
	•	1 cup Mamra (puffed rice)
	•	1 cup Jowar Mamra (puffed sorghum)
	•	1 cup Poha (flattened rice)
	•	1/2 cup Dalia (roasted split gram)
	•	1/2 cup Peanuts

For Tempering:
	•	2 tbsp Oil
	•	1 tsp Mustard seeds
	•	2-3 Green chilies, chopped
	•	1/4 cup Raisins
	•	10-12 Curry leaves
	•	1/4 cup Cashews, split in half
	•	1/2 tsp Turmeric powder
	•	1/2 tsp Red chili powder
	•	Salt, to taste
	•	1 tsp Sugar

Method:

	•	Place Mamra, Jowar Mamra, Poha, Dalia, and Peanuts in an air fryer.
	•	Air-fry at 325°F for 12-14 minutes, shaking halfway to ensure even roasting.
	•	Empty the air-fried mix into a large mixing bowl and set aside.
	•	Heat oil in a pan over medium heat.
	•	Add mustard seeds and let them splutter.
	•	Add chopped green chilies, raisins, and curry leaves. ⭐️Sauté until the chilies are slightly crisp and the raisins puff up.
	•	Add cashews and roast until golden.
	•	Stir in turmeric powder and red chili powder. Mix well and remove from heat.
	•	Pour the tempering over the air-fried mix in the large bowl.
	•	Add salt and sugar. Toss everything together until well combined.
	•	Let the mix cool completely before transferring to an airtight container.

Enjoy your delicious snack mix!

## 706. Recipe⬇️
**@fit.khurana** · 2024-10-27 · video · ❤ 4451 · https://www.instagram.com/p/DBoMcKoKg6r/

Recipe⬇️

Per cookie - 120 Cals, 6g Protein (I made 10 cookies from this dough, you can make 20 smaller ones for 60 cals each)

Ingredients ⬇️
110g sattu
50g Jaggery/zero calorie sweetner
90g unsweetened crunchy peanut butter
60 ml toned milk
Optional - chopped almonds
1 tsp cardamom powder
1/2 tsp cinnamon powder
Pinch of salt
1/4 tsp baking soda
1/4 tsp baking powder

1. Mix together sattu, peanut butter, jaggery, cinnamon and cardamom powder, salt, baking powder and baking soda. 
2. Knead into a dough by adding milk little by little.
3. Once the dough comes together, rest it for 5-6 mins and then shape into cookies.
4. Pre- heat the oven and bake this cookies for 8 mins on 180 degrees and then flip and bake again for 8 mins at 180 degrees.
5. Let it cool down for 10 minutes before you dig in🤤❤️

## 726. 🪔 Diwali Faral 🪔 Episode 3 - Poha Chivda Recipe😋✨
**@thehomelyshef** · 2024-10-21 · video · ❤ 3 · https://www.instagram.com/p/DBYI5a6Rl3K/

🪔 Diwali Faral 🪔 Episode 3 - Poha Chivda Recipe😋✨

✅SAVE NOW, TRY LATER!

This version will keep your chivda fresh & crisp longer with perfectly coated flavors that don’t stick to the nuts!

🌺Recipe🌺

1. Sieve poha first to remove the fine powder, then roast it on low to medium flame with salt till crisp.
2. In oil, fry separately: thin coconut slices, peanuts, roasted chana, curry leaves, & chopped green chilies. Set them aside.
3. In the remaining oil, make a tadka: add mustard seeds, cumin seeds, fennel seeds, sesame seeds, Hing, turmeric powder, red chili powder, coriander powder.
4. Pour the tadka over the roasted poha & mix well.
5. Add the fried nuts to the poha mixture, then sprinkle chaat masala, Amchur powder, & powdered sugar.
6. Mix everything thoroughly and let it cool down before storing in an airtight container.

✨Special Tip:Add all the salt while roasting poha—this helps retain its shape and prevents it from shrinking.

## 727. This festive season, let’s treat our little ones , friends and family with something special that nourishes both body an
**@meghaaddangaich** · 2024-10-21 · video · ❤ 13493 · https://www.instagram.com/p/DBX9oF9S_q-/

This festive season, let’s treat our little ones , friends and family with something special that nourishes both body and spirit—these chocolatey energy bars are sure to be a hit with the whole family! It is packed with goodness of nuts, seeds, honey and dark chocolate. A treat the whole family can enjoy guilt-free. 

Here's an easy recipe for this super healthy & delicious energy bars. 
Ingredients:
* 1/2 cup almonds
* 1/2 cup walnuts
* 1/2 cup cashews
* 1/4 cup pistachios
* 2 tbsps pumpkin seeds
* 2 tbsps sunflower seeds
* 3 tbsps sesame seeds
* 2 tbsps chocolate peanut butter
* 2 tbsps honey
* 1/4 cup dark chocolate (melted)

Instructions:
1. Lightly roast the almonds, walnuts, cashews, pistachios, pumpkin seeds, sunflower seeds, and sesame seeds in a pan over low heat for 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until fragrant. Let them cool.
2. Coarsely chop the roasted nuts & seeds for a better texture in the bars.
3. In a large mixing bowl, combine the roasted nuts, seeds, honey and the peanut butter. Mix well to coat everything evenly.
4. Transfer the mixture to a mould or lined baking dish and press it down evenly to create a uniform layer.
5. Drizzle the melted dark chocolate over the top of the pressed mixture. Spread it evenly. 
6. Refrigerate the dish for at least 2 hours until the bars have set.
7. Once set, remove from the mould and keep it in an airtight jar.

	•	1-2 tbsp hot ghee or oil

	•	1/4 cup Water 
 •  Curry leaves 

Add the ajwain seeds in a mixer grinder with 3 to 4 tbsp water. Then grind it into a fine paste, strain the water to extract the flavor. Keep aside.

In a mixing bowl, combine the besan, rice flour, ajwain water, turmeric powder, chili powder, salt, and asafoetida. Mix well.

Add ghee or a little oil to the flour mixture. Mix it well until the flour becomes crumbly.

Gradually add ajwain water, little by little, and knead it into a soft but firm dough. The dough should not be too sticky or too hard.

Take a portion of the dough and place it in a murukku press with the thin sev plate (plate with tiny holes). Press the dough into the hot oil in circular motions.

## 733. Rajma Pulao
**@mrsyumtum** · 2024-10-19 · video · ❤ 1292 · https://www.instagram.com/p/DBThRW_y9W-/

Rajma Pulao
One pot recipe 
(Serves 1-2)

This recipe is easy to make health my plus nutritious. 

Pre preparation:
-Soak 1/2cup basmati rice for atleast 20-25min. 
-Soak 1/4cup rajma overnight. 

Method: 
-In a pressure cooker, add 1-2tbsp ghee. 
-Add 1tsp jeera, 1-2bay leaf, 1 small stick cinnamon, 2 cloves & 1 big cardamom. 
-Add 1 medium sized onion, 4-5 garlic pods & green chillies in a chopper & finely chop. 
-Cook till light golden brown. 
-Add 1 medium sized potato cut into cubes & the soaked rajma. 
-Add dry spice mix -1/2tsp turmeric powder, 1tsp Kashmiri red chilli powder, 1tsp coriander powder & 1tsp biryani masala. 
-Mix well cover & cook for 5min. 
-Add 1 medium sized tomato finely chopped, 2tbsp curd & fresh mint & coriander leaves. 
-Mix well cover & cook till oil separates. 
-Add the soaked basmati rice and mix well. 
-Add double water & salt as per taste. 
-Pressure cook to one whistle & 3-4min in simmer. 
-Let the cooker naturally depressurise.

## 737. You need this Amazon gadget if you ever want to eat fruits and vegetables safely again.
**@mewguys** · 2024-10-19 · video · ❤ 16175 · https://www.instagram.com/p/DBS2-Sjv_G9/

You need this Amazon gadget if you ever want to eat fruits and vegetables safely again.

We often rinse our produce thoroughly, but the truth is, there are substances that just water can’t remove. That’s where this gadget comes in.

Simply place your fruits and veggies in a bowl of water, turn on this purifier, and toss it in. It uses electrolytic ion purification to degrade toxic substances like dirt, bacteria, and pesticides, making your produce safe to eat.

In about 10 minutes, it automatically turns off, and you’ll notice toxic byproducts floating on the surface.

This has become essential in our homes today, especially with the increase in pesticides and metal toxicity found in our veggies.

## 739. Here’s an easy recipe for Ragi biscuits that your little ones will love! 🍪✨ Made with wholesome ingredients, these bisc
**@cookdtv** · 2024-10-18 · video · ❤ 152868 · https://www.instagram.com/p/DBRD0ZDtEwd/

Here’s an easy recipe for Ragi biscuits that your little ones will love! 🍪✨ Made with wholesome ingredients, these biscuits are perfect for guilt-free snacking! Great for when you want to treat your kids with something homemade!

Here’s the recipe👇🏽

Ingredients :

Butter (softened) - ¼ Cup (50 g)
Sugar - 3 tbsp (30 g)
Almonds - 6 nos
Cashews - 10 nos
Ragi Flour - ½ Cup (100 g)
Cardamom Powder - ¼ tsp
Baking Soda - 1 pinch
Milk - 75 ml (5 tbsp)
Salt - to add to the pot 

Instructions:

1. In a blender, blend Almonds, Cashews and Sugar into a fine powder.
2. Mix this with softened butter and mix well
3. Add the Ragi flour, Baking Soda with Milk and mix everything together.
4. Fill this mixture in a piping bag of any other plastic cover, cut the edges to pipe the batter.
5. In a baking pan lined with butter paper, pipe the batter into small rounds and flatten it.
6. Set Up a makeshift oven with salt in a large heavy bottom pan and heat it.
7. Place a metal stand in the center of the pan and place the baking pan on it.
8. Cover the pan with lid and bake on medium high heat for 22 mins.
9 Allow the cookies to cool and consume.

½ teaspoon chaat masala

½ teaspoon black salt

Steps In Making

1. In a heavy bottom pan add poha and dry roast it for 4-5 minutes on medium to low heat till it becomes crunchy. Once done, remove it in a bowl.

2. In the same pan add 4 tablespoons oil and once it becomes hot add raw peanuts and roast them for 3-4 minutes or till they are almost 60 percent done. They will become slightly dark in colour.

3. Now add almonds and cashews and roast them for 2 minutes or till they get a light golden colour.

4. Further add roasted chana dal and roast them for a minute

5. Now add thinly sliced dried coconut and roast them for another 2 minutes or till they get light golden brown colour.

6. Now add  curry leaves and green chillies and roast them for a minute.

RECIPE BELOW 👇🏽 
🍫 OAT CUPS 🍫 

The most delicious recipe, that involves absolutely no baking. Plus they are vegan and gluten free.

And all you need is 5 ingredients and 5 minutes to prepare them.

Lots of love, 

DB x

INGREDIENTS 

▪️1 cup oats, GF if necessary 
▪️1 tbsp chia seeds
▪️1/2 cup desiccated coconut 
▪️20 dates, pitted
▪️1/4 cup almonds or any nut of your choice 
Toppings (optional): melted chocolate and crushed pistachios 

METHOD

▪️Soak your dates in warm water for at least 15 minutes until dates are soft (drain but save the water) 
▪️In a blender, blitz all the ingredients (apart from toppings). The mixture should hold together, if too dry add 1-2 more dates/water from dates. If too wet, add more oats slowly. 
▪️In a prepared muffin tray, add 1-2 tbsp of the mixture and press down firmly. 
▪️Top with melted chocolate and chopped pistachios. 
▪️Refrigerate until set!

## 753. Is ghee safe for cooking?
**@ral.livezy** · 2024-10-16 · video · ❤ 24907 · https://www.instagram.com/p/DBKw2YmMyPt/

Is ghee safe for cooking?

To know a bit more about cooking methords and the temperatures refer this:

Deep frying often takes place between 150°C and 180°C.

Shallow frying and sautéing are usually around 140°C to 160°C.

Curries some are around 150°C and are brought down at around 100°C during simmering.

Usually most of our Indian cooking is done on ‘high heat’ usually around 140°C to 160°C so pick an oil which is safe at that temperature.

## 756. There are five major types of carbohydrates: monosaccharides, disaccharides, oligosaccharides, polysaccharides, and poly
**@jonnas_kitchen** · 2024-10-15 · video · ❤ 1444 · https://www.instagram.com/p/DBJZICSPO1e/

There are five major types of carbohydrates: monosaccharides, disaccharides, oligosaccharides, polysaccharides, and polyols. 

While any source of carbohydrate can be part of a healthy eating approach, some types are more nutritious than others..
 Some carbs are considered simple, meaning they’re broken down by the body quickly, providing a fast burst of energy. Some are complex, requiring more time to be broken down by the body, thus slowing digestion and preventing extreme changes in blood glucose levels. 

Others are sugar alcohols that aren’t completely absorbed and metabolized by the body, making them less impactful on blood glucose

Buckwheat- called kuttu in Hindi, is technically a seed, and like rajgira/ amaranth is used on days of fasting in North India as well as Gujarat. I love the flavour of buckwheat- pleasantly nutty-toasty, and first had it in the form of savoury crepes when I lived in France, since it isn’t a part of Marathi cooking.

The flour is now easily available in Mumbai, and I love alternating the regular wheat rotis with these from time to time, for some variety for my palate and gut. 

Here’s the proportion & process I follow, try it!

Makes 7- 8 rotis 

You’ll need 1 cup of finely milled buckwheat/ kuttu flour. I used the one from @bhagirathiproducts (not sponsored, really like their flour that is available on @letsblinkit ) 

Heat 1 cup water in a pot, 
along with 1/4 tsp salt
Once it comes to a simmer, lower the heat and whisk in 1 cup of buckwheat flour 

Mix well till the flour is well incorporated with the water, turn off the flame (but let it sit on the gas) and cover with a tight-fitting lid.

After about 5 mins, uncover and transfer to a paraat/ wide plate.
This dough will be steaming hot- so use the back of a vaati/ bowl to knead it initially.

## 772. If you’re on the pill, eat these foods. 
**@nourishyourcycle** · 2024-10-10 · image · ❤ 700 · https://www.instagram.com/p/DA9vKpQJXV1/

If you’re on the pill, eat these foods. 

If you’ve ever been on the pill, eat these foods. 

Honestly, if you’re a woman struggling with your menstrual health and fertility in any way, eat these foods. 😘

All of the organs of your reproductive system and the functions they carry our are built from and run off of nutrients from the food you eat. If you’re not consuming adequate nutrients (and/or if you’re on a medication that depletes them), your reproductive system is not going to function properly, and your menstrual health and fertility are going to suffer because of it. 

B6 is required for estrogen detox and the development of the corpus luteum (aka your ovary’s progesterone factory). 

Folate is essential for the healthy development of a fetus. It also supports the the production of cervical mucus. 

Magnesium is a mineral that relaxes your muscles and reduces inflammation, helping relieve menstrual cramps. It also helps regulate blood sugar levels, which is essential for preventing and managing PMS and PCOS.

Depletions in these nutrients don’t just magically go away after you stop taking the pill, which is one reason why so many women struggle with their menstrual health and fertility after being on it for an extended period of time. 

Imagine your doctor sat you down, told you all of this, and recommended a list of foods to prioritize while on the pill/after you come  …

420cals

- 1 small onion

- 20g pomegranate
- 5 cashews
- 60g dahi
- 10g makhana

Butter Garlic Paneer

Garlic sauce: 
-In the same pan, add some butter.

-whisk well & sauce is ready. 
-at this point if you need more sauce add little water & adjust the consistency. 
-Add the paneer & mix well. Cover & cook for 1min.

Iced Salted Caramel Latte - 225 Kcal for a glass
Ingredients 
2 large pitted dates 
1/3 cup skim milk to soak + 2/3rd for serving 
1 tsp vanilla 
1 pinch salt 
1 shot espresso or 2 tsp instant coffee mixed with 2 tbsp hot water 

Method

2. Blend with vanilla and Salt. 
3. Mix with instant coffee. 
4. Fill a tall glass with ice and remaining milk. 
5. Top with the caramel, mix well and enjoy! 😋

## 789. Palak Paneer Dosa 😍💚
**@chef_modeon** · 2024-10-04 · video · ❤ 272 · https://www.instagram.com/p/DAtXgTRId2w/

Palak Paneer Dosa 😍💚

Ingredient list-

6 leaves of palak
1 green chilli 
2 garlic cloves 
1/2 inch ginger
Salt as per taste
4 tbsp dosa batter
1 cup dosa batter
1/2 cup paneer
Some chilli flakes

Recipe-
1. In a mixer grinder, add palak leaves , garlic, ginger, salt as per taste and mentioned dosa batter to form a paste.
2. Now in a bowl take more dosa batter and mix the palak mixture.
3. On a very hot tawa, sprinkle some water & wipe it with a napkin and then spread dosa nicely.
4. Now add some crumbled paneer & garnish with chilli flakes & enjoy with chutneys!💚

## 792. Recipe:
**@fit.khurana** · 2024-10-03 · video · ❤ 12070 · https://www.instagram.com/p/DAqk-XVi9UK/

Recipe:

Ingredients:
100g Toned milk paneer
100g Cauliflower
80g Pumpkin
5-6 Cashews
1 Cup Slightly Undercooked Elbow Pasta (I am usinh Whole wheat)
Optional - Veggies of choice (mushrooms, bellpeppers, corn)
3-4 cloves garlic
1 tsp olive oil
Seasonings - Salt, Pepper, Red Chilli Flakes, Oregano

1. Boil some whole wheat pasta until slightly undercooked. Please save the pasta water after you drain it.
2. Boil cashews, pumpkin, cauliflower until soft.
3. Then blend everything with homemade low fat paneer until smooth and creamy. You can add the water in which you boiled the veggies while blending everything.
4. Add a little olive oil and saute some garlic, mushrooms and bell peppers in a sauce pan. (Veggies are optional)
5. Now add the sauce we blended along with some pasta water that we kept aside. Add the seasonings and let it cook for 2 minutes.
6. Add in your boiled pasta and let it cook for another 2-3 minutes until desired consistency is achieved. You can adjust the consistency with pasta water.

✨If you loved this recipe, try out my smoked creamy Arrabbiata pasta. Comment “pasta” and I will dm you the recipe❤️✨

## 815. Eggplant tawa fry
**@traditionallymodernfood** · 2024-09-25 · video · ❤ 4215 · https://www.instagram.com/p/DAU4cFHJ7Mt/

Eggplant tawa fry
Ingredients
3 medium size brinjal
curry leaves
To marinate
2 tablespoon pottukadalai
1/2 teaspoon cumin powder
1 teaspoon Kashmiri chilli powder
1/2 teaspoon coriander powder
Small piece tamarind
1/2 teaspoon salt
1 tablespoon sesame oil
1/4 teaspoon turmeric powder
To fry
1 tablespoon sesame oil
Instructions
⭐️add pottukadalai, chilli powder, turmeric powder, cumin powder, coriander powder, salt, and tamarind; grind
⭐️add ginger garlic paste; pulse
wipe the brinjal dry. Cut into thin slice
⭐️add the marination; mix well
⭐️ add oil; mix well and rest for at least 20 minutes
⭐️add oil and place marinated brinjal
cover and cook for 1 minute on both sides
⭐️add curry leaves and cook both sides; serve hot

✨The most effective pro biotic that you need everyday - Ragi kanji / finger milllet porridge but this is made differently to enhance the fermentation to make it very effective probiotic. 

✨Recipe : 

1. Mix 2 tbsp of plain ragi flour / finger millet flour in 200 ml of water. Heat this mixture on medium flame for 3 to 5 minutes untill it thicken & ragi is well cooked. 

2. Take off the heat & add another 100 ml of water to this and let it sit over night for fermentation. This is where the magic of healthy bacteria production happens. 

3. Next morning add 100 ml of curd / butter milk along with salt. The pro biotic powerhouse is ready. 

✨ Best time to consume : 

Can be consume any time of the day, best when consume in the morning before breakfast.

## 826. Healthy and delicious dinner ready in 30 minutes! 
**@dr.vidhichawla** · 2024-09-23 · video · ❤ 5497 · https://www.instagram.com/p/DAP-E-HJpna/

Healthy and delicious dinner ready in 30 minutes! 

Quinoa Khichdi Recipe👇🏻

I N G R E D I E N T S:

1/2 cup yellow split moong dal
1/3 cup quinoa
1 small onion
1 small tomato
1 small carrot
4-5 green beans
1-2 green chilies, slit (optional)
1/2 tsp cumin seeds
1/2 tsp mustard seeds
1 bay leaf
1/2 tsp turmeric powder
1/2 tsp red chili powder (optional)
1/2 tsp coriander powder
1 tbsp ghee 
Salt to taste
4 cups water
Fresh coriander leaves for garnish
Lemon wedge (optional, for serving)

I N S T R U C T I O N S:
1. Rinse the dal and quinoa 4-5 times.
2. Add fresh water and soak them for 30 minutes.
3. Chop your veggies
4. Heat ghee or oil in a pressure cooker on medium flame.
5. Add mustard seeds, cumin seeds and bay leaf, let them splutter.
6. Add chopped onions and green chilly and saute until they become soft.
7. Add tomatoes, cook until tomatoes soften.
8. Add diced carrots and green peas
9. Add turmeric, red chili powder, coriander powder, and salt. Mix well.
10. Drain the soaked dal and quinoa, then add them to the cooker.
11. Pour 4 cups of water and stir everything together.
12. Close the lid and cook for 3-4 whistles on medium flame.
13. Once the pressure releases, open the lid and stir the khichdi.
14. Garnish with coriander leaves and you’re doneeee

I like having khichdi with aam ka achaar, onion and cucumber but that is optional.

## 844. Delicious high protein white sauce pasta with 50g of protein 🤤
**@okaymohit** · 2024-09-17 · video · ❤ 12037 · https://www.instagram.com/p/DABWsUDtC_e/

Delicious high protein white sauce pasta with 50g of protein 🤤

🥗Ingredients:
Whole wheat pasta 50g
Butter 1 tsp
Garlic 5 cloves diced
Onion 1 small (petal cut)
Red, yellow and green peppers 1/4th each
Corn 15g
Broccoli 1 spear
Salt and black pepper to taste
Italian seasoning 1/2 tsp
Oregano 1/4 tsp
Chilli flakes 1/4 tsp

🫙For the white sauce:
Low fat paneer 110g (I’m using farm connect)
Skimmed milk 100ml 
Soaked cashew 10g (dry weight)
Greek yogurt 1 tbsp
Garlic 5 cloves

🍝Recipe:
- Add whole wheat pasta to boiling water with 1/2 tsp salt and cook for 7-8 minutes and strain.
- Sauté diced garlic in butter and add onions. Cook for 2-3 mins 
- Add the rest of the veggies and season with salt and Italian seasoning. Cook for 4-5 mins. Leave a little crunch to the veggies. 
- Blend the ingredients for the white sauce and add to the pan. Season with black pepper, chilli flakes and oregano.
- Add some pasta water to adjust consistency and let the sauce simmer.

-1/4cup water

## 856. A perfectly balanced, high-protein paratha that you can enjoy any time of the day.
**@paulaasra** · 2024-09-14 · video · ❤ 4723 · https://www.instagram.com/p/C_5VfELSx9R/

A perfectly balanced, high-protein paratha that you can enjoy any time of the day.

Nutritional value (approx): 378 cal/serving (2 parathas per person)

C: 50g | P: 21g | F: 10.5g

Before you ask, yes, you can replace tofu with paneer only if you can find a low fat paneer to balance the fat-to-protein ratio. However, I highly recommend trying tofu in this recipe—you’ll barely taste the tofu amidst the flavorful spices and crunchy cabbage. If you’re hesitant about tofu, this is a great recipe to ease into it without feeling overwhelmed. The best part about tofu is its versatility; thanks to its neutral taste, you can flavor it with almost any masala you like.

If you have any questions, comment below or DM me!

Ingredients (Makes 4 large parathas, 2 parathas per person)

🌸For the dough:

120g whole wheat flour
½ tsp ajwain (carom seeds)
30g yogurt
¼ tsp oil

🌸For the filling:

100g cabbage
120g tofu (using Health on Plants)
¼ tsp oil (used ½ tsp in the video as I made extra filling for dinner, also made sandwiches with the leftovers)
½ tsp hing
½ tsp cumin seeds
1 tsp crushed coriander seeds
1 tsp ginger paste
1 chopped green chili
1 medium-sized onion
½ tsp turmeric powder
1 tsp chili powder
Salt to taste
1 tsp chaat masala
Kasuri methi

🌸For the paratha:
Approx ¼ tsp oil/ghee/butter per paratha

## 858. #recipealert Crispy, Crunchy, Juicy Soya Chilli 😋 SAVE the video to try it later :))
**@humbiharsehain** · 2024-09-14 · video · ❤ 911344 · https://www.instagram.com/p/C_5Hst1IYl7/

#recipealert Crispy, Crunchy, Juicy Soya Chilli 😋 SAVE the video to try it later :))
➡️ Steps :-
1) Heat water in a saucepan, add 1 tsp Salt and 1 cup soya chunks, Let it boil for 5 min
2) Transfer soya chunks to cold water. 
3) Squeeze excess water and transfer to a bowl 
4) Add 1 tsp each Black pepper powder, Red chilli powder, Ginger Garlic paste, mix well
5) Add 2 tbsp Cornflour and coat soya chunks well
6) Drop soya chunks in hot oil, fry until crispy and light brown in colour 
7) Remove from oil and keep aside
8) In a bowl mix 1 tbsp Schezwan sauce, 2 tbsp Soy sauce, ¼ cup Green chilli sauce,  ½  cup Tomato sauce, 1 tsp Vinegar,  ½ tsp Salt, 2 tsp Cornflour,  ¼ cup Water. Combine well
9) Heat oil in kadhai, add 1 large tbsp chopped Garlic, 1 tsp chopped Ginger. Sauté well
10) Add one small chopped Onion and fry until light golden in colour 
11) Add 2 green Chilli, diced Onion and Capsicum. Fry on high flame until vegetable loses its rawness 
12) Finally goes in fried Soya chunks and sauce mixture 
13) Mix and cook on high flame for 2 min
14) Finish off with chopped coriander leaves 
15) Serve and Enjoy!!
.

## 865. Tag all Masala Puri Lovers 💕.
**@mad.over.f00d** · 2024-09-12 · video · ❤ 35126 · https://www.instagram.com/p/C_0FWm0Ih_R/

Tag all Masala Puri Lovers 💕.
Bangalore’s famous Street food, Masala Puri. 
Recipe: 
1. Soak 1/2 cup dry Green peas for 5hrs or overnight. Add to a pressure cooker. Pour 1 cup water, salt and cook for 5 Whistles on medium flame.
2. In a Pan heat 1 tbsp oil. Add 2 cloves, 1tsp Cumin, 1/2 inch cinnamon, 4 Garlic cloves, 1/2 inch ginger, 2 green chillies. Next add 1 sliced Onion and Sauté for 3-4 mins in high. 
3  Now add 1 sliced tomato and cook till it softens. Cool and transfer to a mixing Jar. To this add 1/3 cup mint leaves and 2/3 cup Coriander leaves. Add some water and blend to smooth paste. 
4. Heat 1 tbsp oil in a Pan and add Spices ( 1tsp each red chilli, Amchur, 1/2 tsp each Coriander, Cumin and Garam masala powder). Fry for a min on low. Now add the prepared paste and mix well. Add salt and 1 cup water. Cook on low for 5mins.
5. Crush Puris on a plate. Add the cooked peas mixture and the Masala. Top with Onions, Tomatoes, coriander leaves and Sev. Serve hot ❤️.

## 869. What would you pair your Ragi Dosa with?

What would you pair your Ragi Dosa with?

You can watch the full recipe on my Youtube channel! 

Ragi Dosa Recipe

Ingredients:
- Ragi (finger millet) – 80g
- Urad dal (black gram) – 30g
- Boiled idly rice – 30g
- Methi seeds (fenugreek) – 1 tsp
- Rock salt – as per taste
- Water – as required

Instructions:

1. Preparation:
 - Wash the ragi, urad dal, idly rice, and methi seeds 3 times in water.
 - Soak them overnight (or for at least 4 hours if short on time).

2. Grinding:
 - Drain and reserve the soaking water.
 - Use the reserved water to grind the soaked mixture into a batter.
 - Add rock salt to taste after the first grind, and continue grinding until the batter is smooth and fine.

3. Fermentation:
 - Allow the batter to ferment for 4 hours. If you’re short on time, you can skip the fermentation step and proceed immediately.

4. Cooking:
 - Heat a dosa pan on high flame.
 - Splash some water on the pan, then wipe it off with a cloth or paper towel.
 - Pour a ladle of the batter onto the hot pan and spread it evenly into a thin dosa.

5. Optional Additions:
 - For extra flavour, you can add chopped onions, green chillies, and cumin seeds (jeera) on top of the dosa while cooking.

6. Serving:

## 870. crispy honey chilli potatoes w @smallbatch.co.in 🍯
**@shivangipithisaria** · 2024-09-11 · video · ❤ 24216 · https://www.instagram.com/p/C_x1Xb1iqg8/

crispy honey chilli potatoes w @smallbatch.co.in 🍯

This recipe is my take on the best Indo-Chinese starter, elevating it even more with @smallbatch.co.in Roasted Ghost Chilli Honey. It adds the much needed sweetness and this addictive lingering heat which will make you devour the whole thing in seconds!

Recipe:

3 potatoes

- slice potatoes 
- blanch them in water for 7 minutes 
- add to ice cold water immediately 
- pat them dry with a cloth or tissue 

2 tbsp cornstarch + 1 tbsp all purpose flour
salt 
1/2 tsp pepper 
1 tsp red chilli powder 

- mix the dried potatoes with flour and spices and drop them directly into hot oil
- fry on medium high for 4-5 minutes till golden brown and crispy

sauce:
2 tbsp oil
1 inch ginger chopped 
7 cloves garlic chopped
1 red onion chopped

- heat up some oil and sautee aromatics till fragrant and golden 

2 tbsp ketchup 
1 tbsp red chilli sauce 
1 tbsp soy sauce
1 tbsp vinegar 

- add in the sauces and cook for 2 minutes or till thicker

1 tsp cornstarch 
1/3 cup water

## 871. Healthy snacks:Ep 9 CHOCOLATE PUDDING 
**@beautybinges** · 2024-09-11 · video · ❤ 2536 · https://www.instagram.com/p/C_xhcYStYc5/

Healthy snacks:Ep 9 CHOCOLATE PUDDING 
- 1 cup roasted makhana (fox nuts)
- 3-4 soaked dates
- 1 tbsp unsweetened cocoa powder 
- 1/4th cup milk
- A pinch of salt
Method:-
Take one cup of Makhana and roast it on low heat until crispy, take a blender jar add in the roasted Makhana and blend it to make a fine powder.
Soak the dates in warm water for 10-15 minutes .
Add in soaked dates to the blender jar along with cocoa powder, milk, and salt.
Blended until you get a smooth mixture .
Now this mixture in moulds or small bowls of your choice.
Refrigerator it for 3 to 4 hours .
Dust cocoa powder & serve this chilled.
(Tip 💡If if you’re looking to cut out even more calories, then you can replace dates with sweetener of your choice, like Stevia or sugar-free)
Enjoy this sugar free, guilt free snack on your weight loss journey.

## 877. Palakura Pachadi - Andhra Palak Chutney 🥬 
**@diningwithdhoot** · 2024-09-10 · video · ❤ 23728 · https://www.instagram.com/p/C_vEXTdPIqK/

Palakura Pachadi - Andhra Palak Chutney 🥬 

If you think spinach is boring trust me you’ve been having it wrong! Make it this way & watch it become ur favourite recipe 😍 

Recipe: 
- in a blender add 2 tomatoes, 1 onion & 6-7 garlic cloves & blend it into a smooth paste 
- then in a pan, heat oil add 1 tsp jeera, 1 tsp rai/mustard seeds, 1 tsp chana dal, 1 tsp urad dal, 2 dried red chillies, few curry leaves & let it splutter & cook 
- then add 1 tsp coriander powder, 1 tsp red chilli powder, pinch of haldi & 1 tsp salt & cook until aromatic
- then add the paste, cook well until the oil separates from the sides 
- then add 2-3 cups of chopped spinach (it shrinks up so you need to add a sufficient amount) 
- some salt to taste mix well until it cooks & enjoy with hot rice!

Ragi Dosa is a South Indian crepe made with finger millet also known as red millet. These iron and fiber rich dosas are healthy and are made often in South Indian homes. For the uninitiated, dosa is a traditional crepe made with rice and lentil batter. These ragi dosa are a variant of the traditional dosas but ragi is the main ingredient used here. 

In this recipe I made Ragi Rajma Dosa. The batter is made using Urad Dal, Rajma, Oats, and Methi Dana.

I have shared ragi dhokla, ragi malt, sweets, dosas, idli, Roti, Paratha, halwa and many more using ragi. It’s the most tastiest Millet in my opinion. 

Finger millet is considered a super grain due to its high nutritional profile, especially iron and calcium. It is believed that regular consumption of this whole grain is going to keep us healthy and strong. It is encouraged to consume this regularly at least in small quantities to boost our calcium and iron levels.
You can skip oats if you want to, it will still turn out well.

Urad Dal, 1/2 Cup

Salt to taste

1. In a bowl add Urad Dal, Ragi/Finger Millet, Rajma, Oats, Methi Seeds. Wash and rinse.

## 901. Protein Rich Breakfast (15 Minutes!)
**@chefvinnyshukla** · 2024-08-31 · video · ❤ 10306 · https://www.instagram.com/p/C_UsMnqy0cR/

Protein Rich Breakfast (15 Minutes!)
I received so many requests after seeing one of my breakfast stories. Though I had given as post, you asked for a detailed video so, made it for you!😊
Check out the post too where I had made this Cheela with paneer stuffing and peanut Chutney. 
This one is paired with green chutney which has peanuts again. Both tastes fantastic and so very quick to make!!

Cheela / Dosa :
Yellow Moong Dal - 1 cup 
Ginger - 2 inch piece 
Red Chilli - 3 to 4
Cumin - 1/2 tsp
Hing - 1/4 tsp
Chopped Coriander 
Salt

• Wash and soak the Moong Dal overnight or just for 3 hours would do.
• Add it to the mixer jar along with ginger, cumin , red chilli and grind it smooth.
• Transfer it to a bowl and add chopped coriander, hing , salt and the batter is ready.
• You need not ferment this. In medium hot tawa, make Cheela with ghee or oil either crisp or soft however you like it!

Green Peanut Chutney :
Mint & Coriander - 2 handful
Green Chilli - 2
Ginger - 1/2 inch piece 
Juice of half a lemon 
Roasted Peanuts - 1/4 cup
Salt
Water - just enough to grind it smooth.

Grind all this together until smooth and the chutney is ready.

Bajra Dough

1/2 tsp ghee + 1/4 tsp 
1/4 tsp salt 

1) Boil water add 1/2 tsp ghee and salt. Once it comes to proper bubbling boil, let it boil properly for another minute. Add Bandra flour, mix well  and switch off the flame 

2) Keep covered for 10 minutes 

3) Remove on a plate and slowly knead little, add 1/2 tsp ghee if little sticky. Will harden more once cools 

4) after kneading for 3-4 minutes, keep covered for 15 minutes 

5) Dough is ready 

Dust it and roll from a roller or with palms. Make sure you keep sugaring in between so as there are chances of it getting stick to the rolling stone. 

6) Cook on both sides, flip and cook. In the end add some ghee or oil and cook further :)

Note :- Bajra roti tastes best rolled  little thick & cooked until crisp, with some butter or ghee on the top as millets tend to give a dry mouthfeel so ghee helps

If the dough is little sticky don’t worry, add a spoon of flour and knead or else else adding little ghee to your palms will make kneading easier

Sambol is a dish that’s a direct reflection of my childhood at my grandmother’s place. Its is a Srilankan dish that’s made from coconut, very similar to Kerala’s Chamandhi, except that this usually has dried little fishies in it. We’d have to beg Paati to make this everyday for us, but she wouldn’t because too much coconut causes tummy aches in her books, so we had to make do with two to three times a week. The secret according to Paati is rubbing the onions, curry leaves and coconut with your hands, to release it’s juices and also, this one will sound a bit odd, but she would grate in a cheese cube too. This has to be eaten with steamed white bread, slathered with butter and a cup of Horlicks, oh my lord. No one can make Sambol like Paati, even though it’s such a simple dish because all the love just falls off of her hands while she makes this. Do use freshly grated coconut for this recipe, makes a hell of a difference! 

P.S : in no way is this authentic, this is just our adaptation of a wonderful Srilankan dish. 😇

Did you know that bread making isn’t really as hard as you think watching complex videos! Here is a simple breakdown of all the steps required to make a fluffy bakery style bread! 

Recipe
All purpose flour (maida) - 360g or 3 cups
Milk - 240g or 1 cup
Active dry yeast - 7g or 2tsp
Sugar - 30g or 2tbsps (add half in wet half in dry)
Salt - 9g or 1/2 tbsp
Milk powder - 8g or 1 tbsp
Softened butter 60g or 1/4th cup

Yield - 550g bread loaf 
Loaf size - 8inch loaf or half kg loaf
Baking - pre heat oven to 180*c with fan mode on, bake for 30minutes
 - 
1. Activate active dry yeast in room temp (22*c - 30*c) milk, mixed with half of the sugar.
2. In a big bowl, add all purpose flour (maida), sugar, salt and milk powder. Add the bloomed yeast and start kneading. 
3. Once the dough comes together and no dry flour is left, add softened butter. Continue to knead for 15 minutes and then perform windowpane test. This indicated adequate gluten formation in your dough to facilitate a good rise. 
4. Shape dough into a ball and let the dough rise till it triples in size (bulk fermentation). This may take anywhere between 1 hour - 3 hours depending on the temperature. 
5. Deflate the dough and shape into your preferred bread. Let rise again till double in size (second proofing). 
6. Apply some butter on the loaf and bake in a pre heated oven at 180*c with fan mode on for 30 minutes.

## 925. ✨ Lunchbox Packing Hack ✨ 
**@_gigglesandjiggles** · 2024-08-21 · video · ❤ 3119 · https://www.instagram.com/p/C-7BpL8Myly/

✨ Lunchbox Packing Hack ✨ 

Apple and Peanut butter is a nutritious, fulfilling and calorie dense snack. It also makes for an easy snack on the go but the only problem is that apples go brown as soon as you cut them. 

If your child prefers sliced apples then this hack will be a life saver for you. 

There are many ways to stop browning but the salt water method works the best for us. Take a bowl of cold water and add 1 tsp salt to it. Mix the salt and then dunk your apple slices in it. Let it sit there for 5-7 minutes. Drain the water na flat the apples dry. Put them in an insulated jar or snack box and you are good to go. 

Salt acts as a natural preservative and hinders oxidisation and no - Apples don’t taste salty after this. 

Share this with someone who loves to eat Apple and Peanut Butter. 

Follow @_gigglesandjiggles for more such tips.

## 932. SPINACH BASIL PASTA
**@gigi_goes_vegan** · 2024-08-18 · video · ❤ 78936 · https://www.instagram.com/p/C-zVzugIAp-/

SPINACH BASIL PASTA

Protein per serve: 41g
Fibre per serve: 14g

Just a reminder that you can pre-order my book (link in bio) ‘Plant Protein’ for 80+ delicious high-protein, plant-based recipes!

INGREDIENTS (serves 2)
100g (3.5 oz) fresh baby spinach
Handful of fresh basil leaves 
200g (7 oz) firm tofu, drained
4 Tbsp nutritional yeast
15g (0.5 oz) sunflower seeds
Pinch of salt
Drizzle of extra virgin olive oil
200-220 g (7-8 oz) lentil rigatoni
Toppings
Hemp seeds
Chilli flakes
Olive oil

METHOD
Start by cooking the pasta in abundant salted water.
To a blender, add spinach, basil, tofu, nutritional yeast, sunflower seeds, salt, and oil to taste, along with ½ ladle of pasta cooking water. Blend until smooth.
Drain the pasta and combine with the sauce. Feel free to add more pasta water to adjust the creaminess of the sauce to your liking. Serve topped with hemp seeds, chilli flakes and a drizzle of olive oil

## 940. Comment if you want my 20+ Dosa Recipes, I’ll send them to you!
**@somewhatchef** · 2024-08-14 · video · ❤ 79131 · https://www.instagram.com/p/C-pIEH2sBC_/

Comment if you want my 20+ Dosa Recipes, I’ll send them to you!

Dosa, a popular South Indian dish that’s enjoyed for breakfast, lunch, or dinner. Traditionally made with rice and urad dal, dosa batter requires a bit of planning and preparation. But have you ever tried making dosa with oats? Oats dosa is a healthy and easy-to-make alternative that’s perfect for a quick and delicious meal. 

Oats Dosa that’s not only nutritious but also flavorful. With a simple batter made from oats and a couple of lentils (dals), you can have nutritious, crispy, and delicious dosas in no time.

Oats are a type of whole-grain cereal that is packed with nutrients and offers a variety of health benefits.

Ingredients:
* 2 cups Rolled Oats
* 2/3 cup white split Urad Daal
* 1/3 cup Chana Dal
* 1/2 tsp Methi Dana
* Water for grinding/soaking 
* Salt
* Ghee

Instructions:
1. In a bowl, add Rolled Oats, Urad Dal, Chana Dal, Methi Dana, wash, rinse and then soak for 4 hours. 
2. Grind into a batter.
3. Keep at room temperature, overnight/8 hours to ferment.
4. Add salt, mix. 
5. Make Dosa, toast with Ghee to make crispy dosas.
