## 942. Recipe & Macros🔽
**@fit.khurana** · 2024-08-10 · video · ❤ 12847 · https://www.instagram.com/p/C-eyyHiKPFe/

Recipe & Macros🔽

Cals: 480
P: 24g
C: 60g
F: 16g

Ingredients 🔽 (Makes 1 serve)
1/2 tsp olive oil
3 cloves of chopped garlic
1 small onion
2.5 tomatoes (small to medium size)
1 Red Bell Pepper 
85g Low fat Homemade Paneer
2-3 cashews
1 tsp chilli oil
Spices - Salt, 1/2 tbsp chilli flakes, 1/2 oregano, 1/4 tsp pepper
1 tbsp ketchup
30-35g Whole Wheat/Semolina Penne Pasta
Handful of Fresh Basil

Recipe🔽
1. In a Pan, add very little olive oil. Sauté garlic and onion until golden brown. Then add the tomatoes. On the side, roast a bell pepper until charred and then scrap off the black parts.
2. Add some salt and let the tomatoes cook well for 8-10 mins on slow- mid flame.
3. Once the tomatoes are all mushy, blend this mixture with cashews, roasted bell pepper, paneer, and some water. Make a smooth paste.
4. Add 1 tsp of chilli oil in a pan and then goes in this gravy that we blended.
5. Add in the seasonings mentioned along with some ketchup.
6. Let it cook well for 3-4 mins and add the pasta. Mix it all well and add the basil.
7. Cover and cook on slow flame for 5 mins and its ready to serve.

## 946. Comment if you want my 50+ Interesting Millet Recipes, I’ll send them to you!
**@somewhatchef** · 2024-08-09 · video · ❤ 4479 · https://www.instagram.com/p/C-cQHlOPM2b/

Comment if you want my 50+ Interesting Millet Recipes, I’ll send them to you!

Ragi idli are steamed cakes made with finger millets & urad dal. Traditionally idli recipe is made with urad dal and idli rice. Ragi idli are just a variation of the basic idlis where rice is replaced with ragi. There are so many ways these can be made.

Ragi is one of the whole grains we eat the most at home. So I make various foods using them.

I made these Soft & fluffy ragi rajma idli made with fermented finger millets & urad dal batter. These are best served hot with chutney or sambar.

You can skip oats if you want to, it will still turn out well. 

Ingredients: 
Urad Dal, 1/2 Cup 
Whole Ragi Millet, 1 Cup 
Rolled Oats, 1/2 Cup 
Rajma, 1 Cup 
Fenugreek Seeds, 1 Tsp
Water to soak
Salt to taste

Instructions:
1. In a bowl add Urad Dal, Ragi/Finger Millet, Rajma, Oats, Methi Seeds. Wash and rinse.
2. Soak for 6 Hours. 
3. Drain the water, transfer to a blender.
4. Add little water and grind into a coarse batter.
5. Let ferment at Room temperature for 6-8 hours. 
6. Add Salt and pour into the idli moulds and steam for 20-30 minutes.

Caramelized onion and potato sandwich

Recipe:
- start by slicing 1 onion as shown. Then heat some olive oil in a pan, add the sliced onion & cooking until brown 
- while it cooks add 1 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp sugar & keep mixing.

- add the onions to this & mix well

## 960. Recipe🔽
**@fit.khurana** · 2024-08-03 · video · ❤ 67159 · https://www.instagram.com/p/C-M7fobJmtO/

Recipe🔽

For Pizza Sauce:
Ingredients 🔽
3 boiled tomatoes
1 chopped onion
3 dried red chilles soaked in water
4-5 cloves of garlic
Handful fresh basil
Seasoning- Salt, 1 tsp mixed herbs, 2 tsps red chilli flakes, 1 tsp sugar/stevia, 1/2 tsp pepper
1.5 tbsp ketchup

Recipe:
1. Boil 3 tomatoes and blend them in a mixer
2. In a pan, add 1 tsp olive oil and add tha garlic. Sauté until golden brown and then add onion. Sauté for another 2 mins.
3. Then add the boiled tomatoes paste. Cover and let it cook for 4-5 mins.
4. Add a dash of water to adjust consistency and then add ketchup and seasonings.
5. Cook for 3-4 mins and add fresh basil. 
6. Now turn off the gas, let it cool down for 10 mins and using a hand blender, blend this sauce well. Don’t make it too fine. Just make sure its well combined and gets that pizza sauce like coarse consistency.

Protip: Let the sauce rest for 2 hrs before you use it on the pizza base for the flavors to really rise.

For the pizza:
1 Whole wheat pizza base (Millet Amma/ Health Factory/ Gobble/ Baker’s dozen)
150g of low fat homemade paneer (Lightly Sauteed a little with salt and mixed herbs)
2 tbsps of homemade pizza sauce
Veggies of choice
Fresh basil
Parmesan/Mozerella Cheese - 2-3tbsp

Assemble your pizza and bake in oven/airfryer for 10-15 mins at 200 degrees. Please keep checking in the mid so it doesn’t burn.

## 969. 60 Kcal per Piece 😋
**@aathirasethumadhavan** · 2024-08-01 · video · ❤ 10663 · https://www.instagram.com/p/C-HWJFdy_r0/

60 Kcal per Piece 😋
Air Fryer Chilli Pakora (makes 8 pieces - 60 kcal, 3.5g P, 2.3 g F, 11 g C per piece) 
Ingredients 
4 large Bhajji chillies, deseeded and split in half lengthwise 
Few sprays oil
Stuffing -
1.5 potatoes boiled and mashed 
1 tbsp chopped capsicum 
1 tbsp chopped onion 
1-2 tsp chopped chilli (optional - only if your big chillies aren’t spicy)
Handful of chopped coriander leaves 
2 tsp coriander powder 
1 pinch turmeric powder 
1 pinch cumin powder 
Salt to taste 
For the topping -
30 g grated paneer 
30 g grated cheese 
Pinch of salt 

Method
1. Mash together all ingredients for the filling. 
2. Stuff the chillies as shown - make sure to press it in well. 
3. Brush/spray with some oil and air fry at 200 C for 6-7 minutes. 
4. Take it out, and cover with the paneer-cheese mix, again make sure to press it in. 
5. Air fry for another 4-5 mins until it begins to brown and that’s it. Enjoy it hot with a cup of chai or coffee. 🤤

## 972. Zero wheat, Green Mung Burger Buns are gluten free, high protein & perfect if you’re trying to eat a low carb diet.
**@rishita.thalluri** · 2024-07-31 · video · ❤ 23776 · https://www.instagram.com/p/C-EuXfZS8oM/

Zero wheat, Green Mung Burger Buns are gluten free, high protein & perfect if you’re trying to eat a low carb diet.

Green Mung Burger Buns
𝑹𝒆𝒄𝒊𝒑𝒆:
*Green Mung Dal- 1 cup
*Psyllium Husk- 3 tbsp
*Water- 1/2 cup
*Baking Soda- 1 tsp
*Olive Oil- 1/2 tbsp
*Vinegar- 1tbsp
*Salt- 1/2 tsp

𝑴𝒆𝒕𝒉𝒐𝒅:
♥Wash mung dal really well. soak for 6 to 7 hours.
♥ When the dal is soft enough, drain the water & set aside.
♥ In a mixi jar, add soaked green moong dal, half cup water, olive oil & salt. Blend it till smooth.
♥ Pour it out in a bowl, add Psyllium husk, baking soda, & vinegar. Mix gently till everything is incorporated
♥ Let it rest for 5 to 10 minutes. You will see the mixture has become thick.
♥ Grease your hands & shape the batter into balls as shown & place on a greased baking tray.
♥ Airfry/ Bake at 220C for 20mins.
♥ Cool it down & make sliders with choice of filling.

Note: I’ve used standard measuring cups. Don’t add excess water while grinding. After mixing, batter will look a little loose. Let it rest for 5-10 mins. Psyllium husk will fluff up. Baking time might vary. You can ddd herbs to season.

Pack this for office or school tiffins and say bye to processed maida bread!

## 976. 3 Ingredient dessert🥥❤️
**@flavoursbymounika** · 2024-07-30 · video · ❤ 509133 · https://www.instagram.com/p/C-CbesKNaEC/

3 Ingredient dessert🥥❤️

Ingredients :
Fresh coconuts - 2 (large)
Water - 4 cups
Corn flour - 1/2 cup + 1 tbsp
Condensed milk - 200g

Preparation: 
Break the coconut, Scrape the brown part of the coconut and cut into small slices. Add to a blender along with water and blend smooth. Keep a strainer and extract the milk. Again blend the residual and repeat the process for one more time. Add corn flour and condensed milk to it, whisk it without lumps. Keep the pan on stove and stir continuously on medium heat. It will start thickening keep flame to the low and stir without forming lumps. Turn off heat and transfer to greased bowls or moulds. Set it for 15 minutes outside and 30 mins in fridge. Garnish and serve it.

## 977. Try this once and you will end up making it again and again ❤️ #streetstyletawaburger

Ingredients for Tawa Burger:
1 medium onion, finely chopped
1 medium capsicum, finely chopped
2 medium tomatoes finely chopped
5-6 garlic cloves, finely chopped
1 cheese slice
1 cup paneer, small cubes
3 tablespoons oil
2 tablespoons schezwan sauce
2 tablespoons tomato ketchup
1 teaspoon red chilli powder
1 tablespoon  fresh coriander
Salt to taste

To assemble the burger:
4 burger buns
2 tablespoons oil
2 tablespoons schezwan sauce
1 tablespoon fresh coriander

•	In a pan add Oil and add in the chopped garlic, ginger, and green chili.
•	Saute them for 2 minutes and add chopped onions.
•	Add a little salt. Cook till translucent.
•	Add in the tomatoes and cook till it becomes soft.
•	Now add the finely chopped capsicum and cook for 2 minutes.
•	Mix it well and mash it nicely using a potato masher.
•	Once it is mixed and mashed well, Add in the schezwan sauce, and tomato ketchup. Mix well and cook for 2 minutes. and paneer cubes.
•	Add in the cheese now and mix well.

Mushroom Sukka😍

Ingredients for masala:
Dried Red chillies - 4 (medium spice)
Coriander seeds - 1 tsp
Black peppercorns- 1/2 tsp
Fenugreek seeds - 1/4 tsp
Cumin seeds - 1/2 tsp
Fennel seeds - 1/2 tsp
Cinnamon - 1 inch stick
Cloves - 4
Cardamom - 2 pods

Dry roast all of them in medium flame for 2 minutes and grind into fine powder

👉Other ingredients:
Mushrooms - 400g chopped
Onion - 1 chopped
Tomato - 1 chopped
Ginger garlic paste - 1 tbsp
Salt as per taste
Turmeric powder - 1/2 tsp
Green chillies - 2
Curry leaves - 1 sprig
Coriander leaves 
Oil as required 

Preparation:
Heat oil and add onion, fry until translucent. Add ginger garlic paste along with salt and turmeric powder. Fry until the raw smell goes away. Add chopped mushroom and combine. The moisture release from mushrooms and cook until the moisture goes away completely. Add tomatoes and cook further 3 minutes. Add prepared masala 
Green chillies along with curry leaves and coriander leaves. Combine well and serve.

1/4 cup oats 
salt 

- mix the wet ingredients with the dry ingredients using a spatula or chopsticks
- cover and let this proof for 60-90 minutes in a warm place till doubled in volume 
- scoop the batter/dough using a wet spoon (prevents sticking) 
- now you can add the batter to muffin trays, bread baking tins or even panfry them 
- cool the bread completely before serving 🧈 

ways to cook: 

1. bake: 
- add the batter to a muffin tray and let it rise again for 30 minutes
- bake at 210°C for 25-30 min till the muffins turn golden brown and solid

Or 2. Airfry: 200°C for 15 min

3. steam:
- add the batter to a baking tin and let it rise again for 30 minutes
- meanwhile, preheat a steamer or create a steaming situation like i did by placing a plate with holes over boiling hot water and cover with a lid 
- place the baking tin in the centre and steam for 15-20 min till a toothpick comes out clean

## 1003. Instant Jowar paddu/ Jowar appe😍
**@flavoursbymounika** · 2024-07-22 · video · ❤ 3461 · https://www.instagram.com/p/C9tz6zwtGSg/

Instant Jowar paddu/ Jowar appe😍

Ingredients:
Jowar flour - 2 cups
Sooji -  1 cup
Curd - 2 tbsp
Salt as per taste
Cumin seeds - 1/2 tsp
Onion - 1/2 cup (chopped)
carrot - 1/2 cup (grated)
Green chillies - 2 (finely chopped)
Curry leaves - 1 sprig (finely chopped)
Ginger - 1 tbsp (finely chopped)
Coriander leaves - 2 tbsp (finely chopped)
Baking soda - 1/4 tsp
Oil - as required
Water as required 

PREPARATION:
Add jowar flour, sooji, curd and salt in a mixing bowl. Add water gradually and make flowing batter. Rest for 15 minutes and add ginger, onion, green chillies, curry leaves, carrot and cumin seeds. Add 2 pinches of baking soda and mix well. Grease the paniyaram pan and pour batter in the cavities. Flip and fry both the sides. Serve with coconut chutney or tomato chutney.

## 1006. ✨Sprouted masoor Pulav✨
**@buns_and_dosas** · 2024-07-20 · video · ❤ 7257 · https://www.instagram.com/p/C9o7qMBSg_X/

✨Sprouted masoor Pulav✨
Discover the magic of sprouted masoor pulao !! 
This wholesome dish uses a healthy 2:1 ratio of sprouted masoor rice , creating a perfect balance of flavour and nutrition. Pair with carrot raita , papad and pickle for a complete meal . 

Note - 
I like to sprout the masoor a few days and then use it ! 

 RECIPE 
•Heat some ghee and oil in a pan 
•fry potatoe cubes till golden and set aside 
•in the same pan add khada masala (jeera , cinnamon, clove , Bay leaf ) 
•Add sliced onion (2 medium),hing , grated ginger and garlic (1tbsp) , 2-3 slit green chilli , chopped coriander(1 tbsp mandatory ) and Pudina (optional)
•Sauté onions till golden brown 
•Add 1 medium chopped tomato followed by spices (turmeric, Chilli powder, Shahi Pulav masala or garam masala) 
•Sauté the spices just for a few seconds 
•Add 2 cups sprouted masoor, sauté till well combined 
•Add 1 cup soaked basmati rice 
•mix gentle add 1 1/2 cup hot water . Cover and let it cook till the water evaporates. 
•garnish with chopped coriander and serve with pickles, raita and papad 
•Enjoyyyy!

## 1012. Trust me these cheese and corn appe was bomb , its a must try this monsoon 
**@cooking_day_diaries** · 2024-07-19 · video · ❤ 154 · https://www.instagram.com/p/C9msi4PPKpJ/

Trust me these cheese and corn appe was bomb , its a must try this monsoon 

Ingredients

Potato - 2.
Cheese - 1/2 Cup (Grated)  or 3 amul  cheese cubes.
Green Chillies - 2.
Ginger - 1/2 inch.
Oregano - 1/2 tsp.
Crushed Pepper - 1/4 tsp.
Corn flour - 2 tbsp.
Coriander leaves - Handful (Finely Chopped)
Bread Crumbs - 1/4 Cup + 1/4 Cup for Rolling.
salt - As Needed.
oil - to fry.

Preparation
* Pressure Cook  the Potatoes for 3 whistles till it turns soft.
* Grind Ginger + Green chillies + salt into a Paste.
* In a bowl add Potatoes. Mash well with Masher. Add Grated cheese, Green Chilli Paste, Oregano,Crushed Pepper,corn flour,chopped Coriander leaves & 1/4 Cup Bread Crumbs.Mix well. 
* Makes Sure that Mixture Should not have any Moisture in it. 
* Take lemon sized dough & hold tight  balls. 
* Spread the Bread Crumbs in a plate. Roll Each ball over the Bread Crumbs.
* Take Paniyaram/Appe Pan, add oil to each Partition. Then Place these cheese balls in each Partition.
* when it turns Golden, flip the balls using spoon. Flip Couple of times each side, till both sides are cooked & it turns Crisp & Golden. 
* Serve with Green Chutney or ketchup.

## 1013. Cone Pizza 🍕 
**@yumcurry88** · 2024-07-19 · video · ❤ 10103 · https://www.instagram.com/p/C9mIogMskkQ/

Cone Pizza 🍕 

Cone Pizza 
1. Take roti and cut it in half.
2. Now fold it in a cone shape and tuck it using a toothpick. Prepare all the rotis like this.
3. Place it in a baking tray upside down.
4. Bake it at 200 degrees for 3-4 mins until roti becomes slightly crisp.
5. Prepare the stuffing by combining capsicum, bell pepper, onion, paneer, salt, pepper and pizza sauce.
6. Take an oven safe bowl and place all the rotis in it. Remove the toothpick.
7. Add the stuffing in all the rotis. Sprat oil on the rotis. Add mozzarella cheese on it.
8. Bake it at 200 degrees for 10-11 mins or until the cheese melts.
9. Garnish with oregano and chilli flakes.

## 1014. Peanut Tofu?! 👀
**@juliusfiedler** · 2024-07-19 · video · ❤ 16371 · https://www.instagram.com/p/C9mFuoYIdkT/

Peanut Tofu?! 👀

Traditional tofu is essentially made by curdling soybean milk, a process that works for soybeans because of their high protein level. Other legumes usually don’t curdle and, although you can coagulate them into a tofu, won’t give you the firm tofu texture that soybeans do. Apparently, it’s a different story with peanuts, which technically belong to the legumes family… does it work? 🤔

## 1023. Are you a Hide and Seek Lover?

Are you a Hide and Seek Lover? 

RECIPE - 
Melted butter - 60 grams (1/3 cup minus 1 tbsp ) 
Desi khand - 80 grams (1/3 cup) 
Cocoa - 2 tbsp cocoa 
Wholewheat flour - 120 grams ( 3/4 cup + 2 tbsp) 
Baking powder - 1/2 tsp
Baking soda - 1/4 tsp 
Milk- 1/4 cup
Vinegar - 1 tsp 
Chocolate chips - 1/2 cup 

INSTRUCTIONS - 
In a big bowl add melted butter and desi khand . 
Mix it well , add in buttermilk( 1/4 cup milk + 1 tsp vinegar) . Mix again.
Now sift in dry ingredients (cocoa, wholewheat flour, baking powder, baking soda ) 
Form a dough. Let it chill( in refrigerator)  for 10-15 mins . 
Shape cookies, add chocolate chips, cut them in equal squares . 
Bake at 180C for 20 mins approx . 
Let it come to room temp and enjoy.

## 1025. One pot millet sambar rice😍
**@flavoursbymounika** · 2024-07-15 · video · ❤ 27656 · https://www.instagram.com/p/C9b0Odkt5L-/

One pot millet sambar rice😍

Ingredients:
Little millets - 1 cup
Toor dal - 1/2 cup
Sambar powder - 1 tbsp
Red chilli powder - 1 tsp
Turmeric powder - 1/2 tsp
Salt as per taste
Handful of chopped carrots
Handful of chopped beans
Handful of onion wedges
Handful of chopped drumsticks 
Handful of chopped tomatoes 
2 green chillies 
Tamarind juice - 1 cup (light)

For tempering: 
Ghee - 2 tbsp
Mustard seeds - 1/2 tsp
Urad dal - 1/2 tsp
Cumin - 1/2 tsp
Curry leaves - 1 sprig
Hing - 1/4 tsp
Cashews - 10
Dry red chillies - 3 

Preparation:
Wash toor dal and millets until water is clear, soak them for 5-6 hours. Add them to a pressure cooker along with choice of vegetables. Add sambar powder, turmeric powder and salt as per taste. Add 4-5 cups of water and close cooker lid. Cook upto 4 whistles. Open after the pressure release. Add tamarind juice and red chilli powder, mix well and adjust consistency with water. Cook for 2 more minutes and add the tempering. Serve hot with a papad.

## 1027. Healthy Chocolate Bites -
**@yumcurry88** · 2024-07-15 · video · ❤ 11336 · https://www.instagram.com/p/C9bnpY_of72/

Healthy Chocolate Bites -
1. Soak 3/4 cup dates in hot water for 20 minutes.
2. Remove the seeds and water and transfer it to a blender. Add 2 tbsp peanut butter, 1 tbsp milk and 1/4 cup coco powder. Blend it.
3. Transfer it to a bowl, if you feel it’s very sticky, you can add little more cocoa powder.
4. Now use an ice tray and add this dough to each section. Press it down using a finger.
5. Now melt chocolate and add 2 tbsp fresh cream. Mix well.
6. Add this on top of the dates dough. Cover it properly.
7. Refrigerate it for 1 hour.

## 1037. Schezwan chutney 🌶️ 🔥 
**@lets_eat_with_prachi** · 2024-07-11 · video · ❤ 91623 · https://www.instagram.com/p/C9R897qIWLh/

Schezwan chutney 🌶️ 🔥 
The best Indo Chinese dip ever! It’s the nations favourite and I thought I’ll share my recipe to make it at home because homemade is always better. 

Recipe 🌶️🔥
Ingredients:
KASHMIRI RED CHILLIES 20
HOT WATER 
OIL 1/2 CUP
STAR ANISE 2 NOS.
GARLIC 1/2CUP (CHOPPED)
GINGER 2 TBSP (CHOPPED)
CELERY 2 TBSP (CHOPPED)
GREEN CHILLI PASTE 5-6 (CHOPPED)
SALT TO TASTE
KETCHUP 1/2 CUP
RED CHILLI SAUCE 1/4CUP
VINEGAR 1 TSP
SOY SAUCE 1 TSP
SUGAR 1 TSP
BLACK PEPPER POWDER 1 TSP
Method:
🌶️To make schezwan chutney you will first need to deseed & soak the Kashmiri red chillies in warm water for 15-20 mins. Blend it into a purée and set aside. 
🌶️ In a wok heat oil keep the heat very low. Add star anise, chopped garlic let it simmer for 2-3 mins , then add ginger celery or coriander stems and green chillies. Let the raw smell go away. Now we add the Kashmiri chilli paste and cook on low heat for 15 mins.
🌶️ Then we add the mentioned sauces and let it simmer for 2-3 mins. Season it with salt, pepper and sugar. I’ve used black pepper powder, but you can go ahead and add Sichuan peppercorn if you get it.
🌶️ Store it in an airtight container and let it rest for 24 hours before consuming so the flavours develops well.

## 1046. Craving a delicious & healthy dessert for you & your kids without the guilt? Today's I'm transforming the classic choco 
**@meghaaddangaich** · 2024-07-09 · video · ❤ 75960 · https://www.instagram.com/p/C9ML543yWGq/

Craving a delicious & healthy dessert for you & your kids without the guilt? Today's I'm transforming the classic choco lava cake into a health-packed treat with this Ragi Choco Lava Cake that too without the hassle of eggs or an oven.

Ragi, or finger millet, is a superfood that boosts energy, aids digestion, and strengthens bones. Perfect for growing kids and health-conscious adults!

Ingredients:
🧁 1/3 cup jaggery powder
🧁 2 tbsp melted butter
🧁 3/4 cup warm milk
🧁 3/4 cup ragi flour
🧁 1/4 cup cocoa powder
🧁 1/2 tsp baking powder
🧁 10-12 Chocolate chunks/pieces

Method:
🍫 In a bowl, add jaggery powder and melted butter and whisk well.
🍫 Then add in the warm milk and mix again.
🍫 Add the dry ingredients (ragi flour, cocoa powder, baking powder) and mix everything well.
🍫 Now, pour the batter in a greased Appe pan, fill it half.
🍫 Add chocolate pieces
🍫 Then add some more cake batter on the top.
🍫 Cook each side for 5 minutes on low heat, flipping once, totaling 10 minutes.
🍫 Enjoy a healthier treat with every bite!

Note:
1. Make sure the milk is warm.
2. Before use, ensure the chocolate is at room temperature; avoid using hard chocolate as it may not melt properly.

## 1063. Homemade Tofu
**@snehasinghi1** · 2024-07-05 · video · ❤ 106104 · https://www.instagram.com/p/C9B-3zMpkOg/

Homemade Tofu
Why get store bought tofu, when you can easily make it at home from scratch. Let’s make this. 

Wearing @affairesbylevell5 

1 cup soy beans
Water for soaking 

2 tbsp apple cider vinegar (you can also use regular vinegar)
4 tbsp water
Soak the soy beans in water. Cover with a cloth & let it rest for 7-8 hours or overnight at room temperature. 
For every 1 cup of soaked soy beans, use 2 cups of water & blitz it till smooth. Now, using a cheesecloth, strain the soy milk & keep the solids aside. You can use the soy milk for your coffee, tea, smoothies or make tofu from it. The solids can be added to your chilla batter, cake batter, pancake, breads, burger patties, etc.
To make the tofu, add all the strained milk into a saucepan & bring it to a boil. Continue cooking the milk on low flame for 20-30 minutes & remove the foam from top. Add in the vinegar mixed with water. The milk will curdle. Strain the solids into a cheesecloth & wrap it up tightly. Now place a heavy weight on it & put it in a square/rectangular dish. The tofu will harden & take shape within 30 minutes. To finish add the tofu to a bowl with cold water for 10 mins. You can use it immediately or store it in an airtight container with some of the cold water you chilled it in, in the fridge for upto a week. Use it to make stir-fries, add it to your rice/noodles or make high protein dips & dig in.!

## 1070. Moringa Dal/ Mungaaku Pappu🌿
**@flavoursbymounika** · 2024-07-03 · video · ❤ 74992 · https://www.instagram.com/p/C886lchN0EQ/

Moringa Dal/ Mungaaku Pappu🌿

Ingredients:
A handful of Moringa leaves 
2 medium tomatoes (chopped)
Moong dal - 1/4 cup
Toor dal - 1/4 cup
Salt as per taste 
Turmeric powder - 1/2 tsp
Red chilli powder - 1 tsp
Tamarind - pulp extracted from a small lemon sized.
Water as required 

👉For tempering: 
Oil - 2 tbsp
Chana dal - 1/2 tsp
Urad dal - 1/2 tsp
Mustard seeds - 1/2 tsp
Cumin - 1/2 tsp
Dry chillies - 2
Curry leaves - 1 sprig
Hing - 1/8 tsp
Garlic cloves - 5 (crushed)
Green chillies - 3 (sliced)
Coriander leaves

👉PREPARATION:
Wash dal and add moringa leaves, tomatoes, salt, turmeric powder and 1 cup of water to a pressure cooker. Close the lid and cook upto 3 whistles. 
Open the lid after the pressure is gone, mash the dal slightly, add water if required and slow cook for 2-3 minutes. Add tamarind pulp and red chilli powder, mix well and cook for 3-4 minutes. Finally add the tempering as shown in the video and serve it.

## 1075. Recipe and Macros🔽
**@fit.khurana** · 2024-07-01 · video · ❤ 22663 · https://www.instagram.com/p/C84SeL_Jhct/

Recipe and Macros🔽

Protein: 30g
Carbs: 48g
Fats : 18.5
Fiber : 11g

Cals: 475

Ingredients for Green Yogurt Base:
Handful Coriander 
Handful Basil
2 Garlic Cloves
1 tsp Chaat Masala
1/4 tsp pepper
Salt
2 tbsp Greek Yogurt/ Hung Curd (50-60g)

Recipe:
Grind the Coriander, Basil, and garlic and mix it with the yogurt. Season it and its ready. Refrigerate for 15-20 mins so that its thick and not runny.

Ingredients for Paneer/ Tofu Marinade
100g Tofu/ 100g Low fat Paneer (I am using Tofu)
1 Tbsp Schezwan Chutney
3/4 tbsp Ketchup
1 tsp soya sauce
Salt
1 tsp red chilli flakes
1 tsp mixed herbs
1 tsp garlic paste
Half lemon juice
1 tsp sesame seeds

Recipe:
Mix everything well and marinate the tofu well. Refrigerate for 5-10 mins and saute on a grilling pan preferably. Sauté until both sides are golden brown. Use less than 1 tsp oil.

Grab your veggies if choice: Onion, Bell Peppers, Mushrooms etc and saute on medium- high flame for 5 mins and season with salt and pepper.

Grab a big roti (I am using a beetroot wheat roti).
Spread the green yogurt base and then add the grilled tofu along with the veggies. Fold both sides of your roti towards the centre and wrap the bottom with a paper. You may show your wrapping skills or just wrap it lazily like me🙂

## 1076. Vegetable Ragi Soup 🥣 
**@bliss_is_food** · 2024-07-01 · video · ❤ 8525 · https://www.instagram.com/p/C83siy7IH95/

Vegetable Ragi Soup 🥣 
~ Perfect for the current weather 

SAVE IT TO TRY SOON

This delicious comforting bowl of ragi (finger millet) soup is a perfect pick for monsoons 🌧️, rich in iron, calcium, Vitamin C & many more nutrients. ✨

👩‍🍳 INGREDIENTS :
1 tbsp olive oil / ghee / sesame oil
1 tbsp finely chopped ginger
1 tbsp finely chopped garlic 
1 green chilli (as per spice needed)
1 roughly chopped onion
1 cup vegetables of choice (I have used sweet corn, french beans, carrot 🥕& green peas)
1 tsp salt / rock salt (as per taste)
1 tsp black pepper powder 
2.5 cups of water 
Cook for about 8-10mins until the veggies are almost done
3 tbsp ragi flour + 5-6tbsp water (make a lump free slurry)
Add the ragi slurry & stir the soup continuously 
Cook for 7-8mins until the desired consistency is reached & ragi is cooked well
{ You can adjust the consistency of this soup as per your liking by adjusting the quantity of ragi flour & water }

Finish with juice of half a lemon 🍋, garnish with spring onion greens & serve hot! 😇

## 1096. 🌶️ 🧄 Bombat Dosa Batter ! This is a Bangalore style dosa batter. The dosas are super crispy outside & fluffy inside. Y
**@nehadeepakshah** · 2024-06-25 · video · ❤ 7669 · https://www.instagram.com/p/C8oP8PGS-tN/

🌶️ 🧄 Bombat Dosa Batter ! This is a Bangalore style dosa batter. The dosas are super crispy outside & fluffy inside. You can spread it thin or thick as you like. I like it thinner. 

3/4 cup Raw Rice (use sona masori or Ponni rice) 
1/4 cup Ukda Rice (parboiled)
1/4 cup Urad Dal
2 tbsp Poha
2 tsp Chana Dal
2 tsp Toor Dal
3/4 tsp Meethi Seeds
3/4 tsp Salt
2 tsp Sugar

Wash & soak all dals & rice along with methi seeds for 2 to 3 hours. Grind it along with soaked poha & transfer to a bowl. Ferment for 8 to 12 hours

Add salt & sugar to it & gently mix it. 

🌟 Vishesh Tippani
- Whenever spreading dosa, make sure the tawa is not too hot. Splash water and cool it down.
- Cook dosa on Medium Flame & Spread oil / Butter only when it has cooked half way & become slightly dry. 
- Cook until crispy & serve hot

Ep27: Fat Loss Series: Delicious High Protein High Fibre fritters - they can also be used a kofta in your kofta curry 🙃 I’m offering a free pdf consisting all my air fryer recipes- just comment down and you’ll get the pdf automatically♥️

☀️Protein : 30.7 g

 Per Pakoda ( 26 pakodas)
☀️Calories: 21.5 kcal

INGREDIENTS: makes 26 pakoras - using about 1.5 tbsp batter for each 

🌿2 cups shredded cabbage

🌿1 potato sliced

🌿salt to taste

Add all ingredients to a bowl and mix well, let batter rest for 10mins and mix again(cabbage and onion would release a lot of water in the resting phase). No need to add any water in the batter. Now grease airfryer tray with oil and air fry @180C for 12-15 mins or until done. Toss midway.

## 1106. முருங்கை கீரை பொடி| Moringa leaves podi 🔥
**@sakarasaathamum_vadakarium** · 2024-06-22 · video · ❤ 471474 · https://www.instagram.com/p/C8f_kuVvvC4/

முருங்கை கீரை பொடி| Moringa leaves podi 🔥

Video credits- Dr. Sivaraman 

This is one of the best way to make your kids to have their moringa leaves... u can add it to your rice, chapathi, idli & dosa 

A quick recipe 
🌱To a pan add 2 cup cleaned drumstick / moringa leaves.( Wash the leaves and remove the moisture using kitchen towel and dry it under fan for 10 min)
🌱Now to a pan add the moringa leaves and dry roast until it turns crispy.
🌱Now to a pan add 
Channa dal 1/4 cup 
Toor dal 1/4 cup
Black urad dal 1/4 cup
Pepper 1 tbsp
Cumin 1tbsp 
Coriander seeds 1&1/2 tbsp 
White sesame 1 tbsp 
🌱Roast until all changes it colour.
🌱Now remove it from pan and add 1 tsp oil, 5-6 garlic & 3 red chilli.
🌱Roast for a min and add compound asafoetida, tamarind 1/4 inch and roast for few seconds.
🌱Add the roasted dal and grind it.
🌱Then add moringa leaves and oil roasted ingredients and make a fine powder.

✅✅STORAGE - You can store upto 2 months when refrigerated

CARROT & COURGETTE FRITTERS!
Ingredients 
* 1 medium carrots, peeled and grated 
* 1 medium courgette, grated and squeezed 
* 2 small eggs 
* Oil for frying 

Method 
1. Add carrot, courgette and eggs to a bowl and mix (You can season with salt and pepper for older kids and adults).

## 1123. 🌼Save and Share🌼
**@the.food.talks** · 2024-06-17 · video · ❤ 7476 · https://www.instagram.com/p/C8USipfoGuL/

🌼Save and Share🌼
Protein rich Moong Daal Idlis are perfect for breakfast, lunch or dinner. 
If you haven’t tried this yet, try out and thank me later.
Recipe-
1. Wash and soak 1 cup moong daal for 4-5 hours.
2. Drain out water from the soaked daal.  Grind- 1 cup soaked moong daal+ 1 tsp jeera+1 green chili+ 1 inch ginger. Add 2 tbsp water if required to get the desired consistency.
3. Add 1 tsp salt and 1 tsp enough/food soda.
4. Mix everything well.
5. Grease the idli maker with very little oil, pour the batter in the mould.
6. Steam idlis for 7-10 min or until done.
7. Let it cool a little bit before you de-mould.
8.Tadhka- In a pan add 1 tbsp oil and 1 tsp mustard seeds. Let it crackle, then add handful curry leaves. Add 1/2 cup water, 1/2 tsp sugar and little salt. 
9. Pour the tadhka over idlis and serve with chutney

You may skip tadhka if serving with Sambar.

## 1126. Ultimate Homemade cheese 👇😍 must try ✅
**@mynutritionpalette** · 2024-06-15 · video · ❤ 127985 · https://www.instagram.com/p/C8OaF2-IP3r/

Ultimate Homemade cheese 👇😍 must try ✅

1️⃣ take 2 L of milk in a pan slightly heat it to the point that your fingers can bear it. Turn the flame off.

2️⃣ add 1TBSP vinegar and stir, repeat this step until the milk is completely curdled. It will take approximately 5TBSP vinegar to completely curdle milk.

3️⃣ cover it with a lid and let it rest for 5 to 10 minutes. 

4️⃣ Meanwhile we will prepare a solution of 1TBSP water , 1TSP citric acid , 1TSP baking soda. This acts as an emulsifiers that helps to blend cheese into a smooth paste.

 5️⃣ now add curdled Cheese, above solution, 5 to 10 g of butter, 1/3 cup of milk into a blender ( reduce the quantity of milk, if you want to have a solid cheese block ) and blend together

6️⃣ If you’re not adding the flavours do it then add salt in the above step .

7️⃣ now at flavours like chopped jalapeños, olives, sun-dried tomatoes, crispy garlic.

8️⃣ mix it well store it in a greased container overnight. 

9️⃣ enjoy with your sandwiches, pasta or any other dish.

## 1129. Enjoying crispy Ragi Dosa! 🌾✨ 
**@thenutricookhouse** · 2024-06-14 · video · ❤ 1318 · https://www.instagram.com/p/C8Mmu0sPdRt/

Enjoying crispy Ragi Dosa! 🌾✨ 
High in fiber, rich in calcium, and packed with nutrients.
Ingredients:-
- Ragi (Finger Millet) - 1 cup
- Urad dal (Black Gram) - 1/2 cup
- Rice flour - 4 spoons
- Salt - 1 tsp
- Water - as needed
- Oil - for cooking
Instructions:-
 - Wash the ragi and urad dal thoroughly 2-3 times. 
 - Soak them together in water for 5 hours.
Making the Batter:
- Drain the soaked mixture and add a little water.
- Grind it into a smooth batter.
- Mix in 4 spoons of rice flour.
- Cover the batter and let it ferment overnight.
Next Day:-
- Add 1 tsp salt and 3-4 tbsp water to the fermented batter.
- Mix well.
- Heat a dosa pan.
- Pour a ladleful of batter and spread it 
- Drizzle a little oil around the edges.
- Cook until the dosa is crisp and golden.
- Enjoy your crispy ragi dosa with your favorite chutney.
Serves 8 to 10 dosas
.

## 1133. ✨ Kanji / fermented rice water should be consumed everyday given gut issue is a common concern among majority. 
**@consciouslivingwithshalini** · 2024-06-12 · video · ❤ 41000 · https://www.instagram.com/p/C8HTQfYyuNO/

✨ Kanji / fermented rice water should be consumed everyday given gut issue is a common concern among majority. 

✨ Recipe : 

1. In a bowl (preferably earthen pot) add 4 tbsp of well cooked rice + 150 ml water + 3 tbsp curd / yoghurt. 

2. Let it sit all night & ferment for atleast 8 to 10 hours 

3. You will notice bubbles or a layer of froth indicating good fermentation next mroning

4. Either smash the rice well using your palms or use a blender 

5. Do not discard the soaked water, that is the most important part. 

6. Add salt, also can add chopped onions for better taste 

✨ The best time to consume is in the mornings any time, either empty stomach or as a mid morning drink. 

✨ Can be consumed everyday ! That’s the best gut health practice.

## 1134. Ammamma 👌
**@rohinis.kitki** · 2024-06-12 · video · ❤ 375850 · https://www.instagram.com/p/C8HGibjSv_M/

Ammamma 👌

This video is a raw footage of mom making our favorite curry leaves moringa podi amidst power cuts and thunderstorms last evening 😊 Only love 💚💚💚

Mom has so many variations of green podi - main ingredient being curry leaves. This version is a combination of moringa leaves, curry leaves, black and white sesame seeds and some spices. Super nutritious and yum!

You can devour it with hot ghee rice or top your idlis, dosas, upma, salads, sandwiches and so on.

RECIPE 👇
Take equal quantities of Curry Leaves and Moringa Drumstick) Leaves. You can skip Moringa if you don't find.
Wash and dry the leaves.

Microwave them for 1-2 minutes as per the quantity and water content. You can SUNDRY them as well for a day if weather permits.

Roast 3 spoons dhania seeds and cumin seeds. Add 1 spoon each of cloves, cinnamon, black pepper and 3-4 red chillies. 
Quantities can be adjusted as per your taste.

Roast 1 handful each of black and white sesame seeds.

Blend the spice mix with tamarind and some rock salt. Blend the dry leaves too. Let it cool. Now add the sesame seeds too and blend once.

And then you can add few crushed garlic and blend if you like. Adds a nice flavor. 

Podi is ready.

Optional: you can add roasted flax seeds too. We forgot to add while making but added later 😝

Tip: Don't blend the sesame seeds too much as they might release oil and make the podi clum …

## 1135. Palakura Ulli Karam 
**@snehasinghi1** · 2024-06-12 · video · ❤ 12098 · https://www.instagram.com/p/C8GwOltpobx/

Palakura Ulli Karam 
This is one of the easiest & most delicious ways to include spinach in your diet. It tastes fabulous & you won't be able to stop eating it. Let's make this.
Wearing @prakassaofficial_ 

2 onions, roughly chopped 
1 tbsp oil
1 tbsp chana dal
1 tbsp coriander seeds 
1 tbsp jeera
2 dried red chillies 
1 small piece of tamarind 
Salt to taste 
1 tbsp oil
1 tbsp jeera
10-15 curry leaves
4-5 cloves of garlic, sliced
1 bundle spinach
1 tbsp red chilli powder 
Add the oil to a pan. Add in the chana dal, coriander seeds, jeera, dried red chilli & cook for 20 seconds. Add the onions, tamarind, salt & cook for 3-4 minutes till the onions are slightly soft. Once slightly cooled, blitz into a coarse paste & keep aside. 
In the same pan, heat some oil. Add in the jeera, curry leaves, garlic & cook for 30 seconds. Add the spinach & cook for 2-3 minutes. Add in the blitzed onion paste & mix well. Add the red chilli powder, salt (if needed & mix well. Serve hot with steamed rice & dig in.!

## 1136. Vaangi bath 🍆🍚
**@theiyerpaati** · 2024-06-11 · video · ❤ 1008 · https://www.instagram.com/p/C8EaP_yot3D/

Vaangi bath 🍆🍚

Vangi Bath is a vegetarian South Indian dish that originated in Karnataka, Mysuru region.
Vangi means brinjal (eggplant) and bhath means cooking together. Mostly viewed as a dry dish, it is accompanied by Mosaru Bajji or Raita. 
Traditionally, the dish is prepared using younger, green brinjal. Although any variety of brinjal can be used in the creation of the dish, though the final result may differ between the varieties

Ingredients:
-	2-3 long green brinjal, chopped into pieces
-	1 tbsp oil
-	1 tsp mustard seeds
-	1 tsp chana dal
-	½ cup peanuts
-	Curry leaves
-	¼ tsp turmeric powder
-	1.5 tsp Vangi bath powder
-	Salt
.

## 1146. This sauce 🤌🏼🤌🏼🤌🏼
**@aathirasethumadhavan** · 2024-06-08 · video · ❤ 38832 · https://www.instagram.com/p/C78VgTlS5KF/

This sauce 🤌🏼🤌🏼🤌🏼
Creamy Caramelised Onion Pasta
Recipe (makes 2 servings - 370 Kcal, 17 g P, 9 g F, 59  g C per serving)
Ingredients 
1 tsp lote butter
1 tsp olive oil
4 onions, sliced thinly
1 tbsp chopped garlic
1 tsp soy sauce
1 tsp chilli flakes
1 tsp italians easoning
1 tsp peri peri seasoning
100 g tofu/paneer belnded into a puree with some hot water (optionally can add 1 tbsp cream cheese to this too)
200 g cooked spaghetti (about 100 g dried pasta)
1-2 tsp sugar
Reserved pasta water
Salt to taste

Method 
1. Melt butter and olive in a pan. Add in the sliced onions with a pincg of salt, and let this cook on a low - medium heat.
2. Keep stirring and make sure the ehat is low - this gives it time toc aramelise. Add a little water every now and then to speed up the process.
3. Once it becomes caramelised, add int he garlic and cook for a few more minutes.
4. Then add in the soy sauce and seasonings.
5. Mix well and add the tofu/paneer puree along with some pasta cooking water.
6. Season with sugar as necessary, and once it becomes a glossy sauce, add in the cooked pasta.
7. Finish off with more chilli flakes and oregano if necessary and enjoy!
.

## 1151. Travel friendly dal khichdi 
**@the_kidsdoctor** · 2024-06-07 · video · ❤ 16698 · https://www.instagram.com/p/C75rT06R16b/

Travel friendly dal khichdi 

Ingredients 

Rice 
Moong dal 
Masoor dal
Jeera
 turmeric 
Hing Namak

Recipe 

Take 1 cup rice. Add 1/4 cup yellow moong dal and 1/4 cup masoor dal. 
Add water and wash it several times. 
Drain excess water and Let it dry overnight.
Blend in a blender to form a coarser mixture or you can also make a fine powder for babies below 1 year.
Now in a pan, add ghee, jeera , haldi 
Add the mixture and roast it. Add salt to taste ( for BELOW 1 YEAR- DO NOT ADD SALT WHEN YOU PREPARE ). Mix and roast well 
Let it cool down and put into an air tight container.
To make khichdi ,you can use this powder anytime- just take 2 spoons and add 1/2 cup water. Stir and cook on low flame. Keep adding water to cook it well.

You can give this to children above 1 year. And store it in a cool dry place for your travel, upto 4 weeks .

## 1152. Ragi Idli - 
**@thenutricookhouse** · 2024-06-06 · video · ❤ 1260 · https://www.instagram.com/p/C74DVkRv7uh/

Ragi Idli - 
Start your day with a nutritious twist! 🌟 
the perfect blend of health and taste. Rich in calcium and fiber, these idlis are a delicious way to power up your mornings. 🥄✨
Ingredients:-
- 1 cup whole ragi
- 1/2 cup split urad dal
- 2 tbsp idli rava
- Salt to taste
- 1 tsp oil/ghee for greasing
Recipe:-
1. Soak whole ragi and split urad dal  for 4-5 hours.
2. Grind  into a smooth batter.
3.  Add rava and salt, mix very well
4. Cover and rest 7-8 hrs or overnight for fermentation process.
5. Grease idli molds with oil/ghee and pour the batter into the molds.
6. Steam for 25 to 30 minutes or until cooked through.
7. Serve hot with chutney or sambar.
.

Try this delicious Peanuts Sundal! 🥜✨ Packed with protein, healthy fats, and essential vitamins. Perfect for breakfast and evening snack 
Ingredients:-
- Peanuts: 1 cup (boiled)
- Fresh Coconut: 2 to 3 tbsp
- Oil: 1 tbsp
- Mustard Seeds: 1/2 tsp
- Urad Dal: 1 tsp
- Curry Leaves: 10 to 12
- Dry Red Chilli: 2
- Chaat Masala: 1 tsp
- Salt: 1 tsp (or to taste)
Instructions:-
1. Heat oil in a pan over medium heat.
2. Add mustard seeds and let them splutter.
3. Add urad dal and sauté until golden brown.
4. Toss in the curry leaves and dry red chillies. Sauté for a few seconds.
5. Add the peanuts and stir well.
6. Mix in the fresh coconut, chaat masala, and salt.
7. Cook for another 2-3 minutes, stirring occasionally.
8. Serve hot or at room temperature. Enjoy!

## 1158. Comment if you want my 30+ Indian Recipes, I’ll send them to you!
**@somewhatchef** · 2024-06-04 · video · ❤ 104556 · https://www.instagram.com/p/C7yVL-SMxe1/

Comment if you want my 30+ Indian Recipes, I’ll send them to you!

Pahadi Aloo Ke Gutke (Aloo Gutuk) is a traditional snack or side dish from Uttarakhand in India.

It is a popular Kumaoni dish (a region in the Indian state of Uttarakhand) served as a side dish with mandua ki roti, dal, bhatt chutney, and Pahadi Kheere Ka Raita. 

The word ‘Gutke‘ in the Kumaoni dialect means pieces.

This easy-to-make potato dish comes together in under 20 minutes using simple ingredients.

Traditionally, aloo gutuk is made from a special variety of local mustard seeds known as lai or bachha rai, but you can also use regular mustard seeds.

Ingredients:
4-6 potatoes 
1/2 piece Ginger
2 green Chillies
1 Tbsp Coriander Seeds
1 Tsp Chilli Powder 
1/2 Tsp Garam Masala
1 Tbsp Water
1 Tbsp Mustard Oil
1 Tsp Mustard Seeds
1/2 Tsp Jeera 
1/2 Tsp Heeng
Coriander to Garnish

Instructions:
* Parboil potatoes in a pressure cooker for 2 whistles. Remove the skin and roughly dice the potatoes.
* In a stone grinder, add ginger, green chillies, coriander and coriander seeds. Grind together. Add chilli powder, garam masala and water. Mix again. 
* Heat oil in a kadhai until fuming hot, reduce the heat. Add asafoetida, mustard seeds, cumin seeds, red chilli, Pahadi masala and fry for a minute. 
* Add diced potatoes and mix well.
* Turn off the heat. Garnish the potatoes with fresh coriander leaves.

## 1172. Recipe & Macros👇🏻
**@fit.khurana** · 2024-05-28 · video · ❤ 6095 · https://www.instagram.com/p/C7gtj_MJzKe/

Recipe & Macros👇🏻

Per Protein Bar:
261 Cals
21g Protein
9g Fats
24g Carbs

🔴 Store in fridge upto a week and consume cold

Ingredients for 8 Protein Bars:
5 Scoops Chocolate Whey (Per Scoop 25g P) - 130g
100ml Double Toned Milk
80g Deeseded Dates (Sticky dates, not the dry ones)
15 Cashews 
120g Instant Oats (Roasted & then Powdered)
70g Unsweetened Peanut Butter Crunchy
10g Cocoa Powder Unsweetened (Hersheys)

For Garnishing (Optional)
6-7 Cashews Roasted & Chopped
10 Almonds Roasted & Chopped

Process:
1. Soak 15 Cashews and Dates in warm double toned milk for 1 hour and then blend this into a smooth paste.
2. In a Bowl, add powdered oats, protein powder, cocoa powder, date cashew paste, and peanut butter
3. Knead this into a dough. It will require 10 minutes to come together so be patient. You may add 30-40 ml milk after 3-4 mins of kneading and it will quickly come together. (It may seem quite sticky and powdery at first, but keep kneading. Incase you are not able to get the perfect dough even after adding some milk, add a tiny bit of peanut butter)
4. Once the dough is ready, transfer into a rectangle box or cake tin lined with butter paper to get the shape right. Then press it down with your hands to give it shape and make it even. Try making it thinner and longer to achieve 8 bars. (Don’t be like me🫣, I didn’t flatten & make it long enough and only got 6 thick bars) …

## 1173. Paneer 65 🌿 a spicy South Indian treat! 
**@diningwithdhoot** · 2024-05-28 · video · ❤ 11323 · https://www.instagram.com/p/C7gs8YvIO1H/

Paneer 65 🌿 a spicy South Indian treat! 

Crunchy on the outside but pillowy soft on the inside! It’s such a delicious recipe that is prepared in no time! 

Recipe: 
- cut 200g paneer into cubes as shown
- then coat that with 2 tbsp corn flour & toss with a light hand 
- then in a bowl add 4 tbsp Maida / all purpose flour, 1 tsp red chilli powder, 1 tsp garam masala, 1 tsp salt, 1 tbsp ginger garlic paste, 1 tsp cumin powder, 4 curry leaves finely chopped & 1/4 cup yoghurt & 1/4 cup water. Mix well. You can add more water but be careful as you need a thick batter not a thin one 
- now add the paneer cubes & coat in the thick batter 
- now heat up oil. Only once hot drop the paneer pieces into it. Don’t over crowd & fry it in batches 
- once fried set aside 
- in a pan heat 1 tsp oil then add 3-4 garlic cloves finely chopped, 2 green chillies slit & chopped as shown & 8-10 curry leaves 
- then add fried paneer cubes & toss in the wok 
- serve hot & enjoy 💃🏻

20yrs of experimenting…. I think I have managed to figure out the best type of rice available here in the US for getting the perfect caramelized brown color for dosé. 

I have been doing Nth round of  experimenting the last few months with the popular idli rice and sona masoori. Using idli rice makes the dosé more softer and airier which is perfect for spongy set dosé popular in the Bangalore darshinis. 
If using only sona masoori , the dosé are more crispy in texture making a good candidate for paper dosae.
But using 1/2 and 1/2 of both gives the perfect texture.

Recipe
1cup sona masoori 
1 cup idli rice 
1/2 cup urad dal 
1/2 cup poha
Few methi seeds
1Tbsp Chana dal

Quick Cottage Cheese balls ; This air fried cottage cheese balls are so simple and tasty ke baar baar khaane ka mann karega. Prep time aur cooking time main toh Netflix ke ek episode bhi khatam nahi hota

Ingredients -
1. Crumbled paneer/cottage cheese 100gm
2. ⁠Bread slices 2-3 
3. ⁠medium chopped onion 1
4. ⁠chopped coriander 1/4 cup
5. ⁠chopped chilli 1 (optional)
6. ⁠Salt to taste 
7. ⁠roasted cumin powder 1 tsp
8. ⁠red chilli powder 1 tsp
9. ⁠chaat masala 1 tsp

Recipe -

4. ⁠Mix all the ingredients well so that the mixture resembles a dough. 
5. ⁠Roll into equal-sized balls.
6. ⁠Air- or deep-fry and serve hot with ketchup or chutney.

Cheesy caramelised onion spread/dip 🌿high protein 🌿fat loss friendly

Caramelise onions by cooking them on low flame until they turn brown. Add chopped garlic in between. Add paneer, yoghurt, salt, pepper, honey and ACV in a blender and blend. Add a layer of the spread, lots of thinly sliced cucumbers( you can add more veggies of choice to increase fibre) and sliced eggs. Top with some chilli flakes and enjoy!

## 1194. THAT’S A WRAP: EPISODE 2 🌮 
**@nourishing.niki** · 2024-05-15 · video · ❤ 16944 · https://www.instagram.com/p/C6_gYd3qLKM/

THAT’S A WRAP: EPISODE 2 🌮 

QUINOA WRAPS made with just quinoa, water and salt 🤌🏼

These are incredibly easy to make and honestly there’s something so satisfying about making your own wraps/tortillas 🥹

They’re perfect to wrap up your favourite fillings, use them for tacos or with some curry or even (my personal favourite) spread some cream cheese in, roll it up and *chef’s kiss* 🤌🏼

Don’t forget to SAVE this recipe for later 😘

(Makes 4-5 medium wraps or 3 large wraps - double quantities for more 👏🏼)

- 100g uncooked quinoa
- 125ml water
- 1/2 tsp salt

1. Rinse quinoa then leave to soak for at least 3 hours (I like to put them in water before bed then make the wraps in the morning).
2. Drain and rinse the soaked quinoa.
3. Add quinoa, 125ml water and salt to a blender and blend until smooth.
4. Scoop 1/4 cup of the mixture into a non-stick pan (spray with cooking spray just in case) and spread to the edges of your pan. Leave for 3-4 minutes or until the bottom is cooked, flip and cook for another minute or so. 
5. Store at room temperature for up to 3 days or in the fridge for up to a week. 

TOP TIP: run some cold water into your pan and rinse to cool down your pan between cooking each wrap. This makes spreading them into a tortilla much easier!

## 1202. Homemade peanut butter crackers for my 23 months old toddler👦🏻
**@thanmayeeobili** · 2024-05-10 · video · ❤ 3 · https://www.instagram.com/p/C6yiqFaSgnE/

Homemade peanut butter crackers for my 23 months old toddler👦🏻

Ingredients: 

🌼 1/2 cup Peanut butter
🌼 1/3 cup Honey
🌼 1/4 tsp Salt
🌼 1/2 tsp Cinnamon
🌼 1/2 tsp Baking Powder
🌼 1¾ cups Oats

Method: 

- Place the oats into the blender and blend into flour.
- Melt peanut butter and add honey to it and mix well.
- Add baking powder, salt, cinnamon and mix.
- Add oats flour and mix until a dough forms.
- Place the dough between two parchment papers and roll thin.
- Remove the upper parchment and cut the dough into rectangles as shown in the video.
- Bake in a preheated oven at 180 degrees until the edges are golden. (It took me 6mins)Remove from oven and allow to cool completely.
- Separate the cookies/crackers and enjoy!

Note: keep checking in between. The first batch I made got burnt within just 9mins(I kept alarm for 10mins)
So, for the second batch, I kept checking at 4mins and 6mins. If you touch it immediately, you might find it soft but once the edges are golden brown, just remove from oven and let it cool completely.

## 1209. Spicier than your love life :)
**@alaukikjainn** · 2024-05-07 · video · ❤ 11906 · https://www.instagram.com/p/C6rIqyeomjq/

Spicier than your love life :)
(non-existent) (same boat Dw 🤗)

Crispy Chilli Cauliflower 🌶️
Ingredients: (for the cauliflower)
- 1 small cauliflower
- 50-60 grams bread crumbs
- 3 tbsps whole wheat flour (+ spices optional)
- 1 tsp salt
- 1/4 cup water

Ingredients: (sauce)
- 1 tbsp dark soy sauce
- 1 tbsp peanut butter
- 3 cloves of garlic finely chopped 
- 1 inch ginger finely chopped 
- 2-3 tbsp oil
- 2 red chillies chopped
- Sesame seeds (optional)
- 1 tsp honey

Method:
- Wash cauliflower in water + vinegar + soda mixture. Then rinse with water properly. (Important to remove all the worms and dirt)
- Then pluck the florets. In a bowl mix the flour, water, salt, spices (optional) adjust the mixture with water if needed. (Same consistency as Vada pav or dosa batter)
- Dip in the batter, roll over the panko and air fry for 10 minutes at 180 *C and 5 minutes at 200*C for the colour.
- Combine all the ingredients except the oil, heat the oil and pour it over the mixture. 
- Once done, pour the sauce over the cauliflower and shake! You’re done! Enjoy Crispy Chilli Cauliflower now :)

Adjust the chilli accordingly :) the addition of extra chillies made it spicy 🌶️

Making your own healthy, bubbly gut friendly probiotic drink at home is such a fun and simple activity!

It is a 2-step activity: 

PART 1: 
First you’ll need to make Ginger BUG!🫚

Ingredients you’ll require :
1.5 cups of water
3 tablespoons of jaggery 
3 tablespoons of grated ginger (with skin)

Take equal volumes of grated ginger and jaggery in a glass jar. Fill it with enough water to submerge it and give it a good mix. Cover it with a cloth and keep it aside for 2-3 days in a shaded place. Ginger will start floating up. You will notice a thin layer of bubble which is an indication that it’s ready and beneficial bacterias have formed. Since, it is a living drink, make sure to feed these bacterias every 2 days with some jaggery and ginger to maintain the vitality of this mixture.

## 1222. Day 10: Homemade healthy 2-ingredient vegan ice cream for babies & toddlers
**@loudmumma** · 2024-05-02 · video · ❤ 463 · https://www.instagram.com/p/C6dbgpsv0nd/

Day 10: Homemade healthy 2-ingredient vegan ice cream for babies & toddlers

This watermelon ice-cream is a MUST try! It’s quick and easy. You only need 2 ingredients and 10 minutes and you’ll be well on your way to enjoying this refreshing, flavorful, healthy treat with your baby.

🍦Share this with someone who’d love try this for their kids & don’t forget to save it to make later.

Follow @loudmumma for more such healthy recipes for your baby 

Ingredients:
- Cubed frozen watermelon
- Coconut milk

👉🏻If baby is above 1 year you can use milk

🍨How To Make Watermelon Ice-Cream:

✅ This recipe starts with frozen watermelon. To freeze the watermelon, I like to take cubed watermelon put in air tight container and freeze for at least 4 hours.

✅Once your watermelon cubes are frozen, pop them into a high speed blender with the coconut milk.

👉🏻Blend until the watermelon has broken down and you have a thick, creamy consistency. To eat it immediately (which is my kids favorite way to enjoy this), serve and enjoy!

If you want to eat the watermelon ice-cream later, transfer to a loaf pan and place back in the freezer.

This is the best vegan, gluten free ice cream for babies and toddlers.

## 1224. I made these changes almost 1.5yr back. Why??
**@baby_led_parenting** · 2024-05-01 · video · ❤ 33898 · https://www.instagram.com/p/C6bKvBEoD_A/

I made these changes almost 1.5yr back. Why??

1. The flour derived from Khapli wheat is known to be higher in protein compared to regular wheat, making it a valuable source for people looking to meet their protein requirements. Additionally, it consists of more essential nutrients and is easy to digest. Moreover, it is rich in fibre, proteins (already mentioned) and vitamins, making it especially good for people with diabetes, gluten intolerance and pregnant women.

2. Sona Masoori rice is light and easy to digest. It's rich in carbs and low in calories. Its lower glycemic index aids blood sugar, hence making it diabetes friendly. It has zero fat and low sodium compared to other rice varieties. Due to low sodium, you don't have to worry about elevated blood pressure and cholesterol levels.

3. Bay leaves are full of antioxidants and are a good source of minerals and fibre. Adding it while cooking rice permeates the grains with its essence and gives rice dinner a pleasant backdrop.

## 1228. Save the recipe to try later ✅ Blueberry Ice Cream 
**@modernmamatales** · 2024-04-29 · video · ❤ 39370 · https://www.instagram.com/p/C6VyFNryc2T/

Save the recipe to try later ✅ Blueberry Ice Cream 

💫 For 8 months plus babies

💫 Skip dates for babies below 12 months. 

💫 Don’t add more than 1-2 dates for babies below 24 months

Ingredients:

 • 3 ripe bananas 🍌 
 • Almonds (soaked for 6-7 hours) 🌰 
 • 9-10 blueberries (soaked for 30 minutes) 🍇 
 • 2 dates (optional for sweetening) 
 • 1/2 cup water 💦 

Instructions:

Preparation:
 • Slice the bananas and freeze them overnight or for 6-7 hours.
 • Soak almonds for 6-7 hours, then remove the peels.
 • Soak blueberries and dates separately.

Make Almond Milk:
 • Blend soaked almonds with 1/2 cup of water until smooth. Fresh almond milk is ready.

Prepare Ice Cream Mixture:
 • In a blender, add frozen bananas, soaked blueberries, and dates (if using).
 • Pour in the almond milk.
 • Blend for 30 seconds and stir well. Repeat this process 3-4 times until you get a smooth paste.

Freezing:
 • Transfer the mixture into a bowl or a tin, spread it evenly.
 • Garnish with chopped blueberries.
 • Cover with cling film to avoid ice residues.
 • Freeze for 5-6 hours until set.

Serve:
 • Once frozen, scoop out the homemade natural ice cream.

Enjoy this delightful treat with your baby!

## 1229. Sambar powder 🥘🍛
**@theiyerpaati** · 2024-04-29 · video · ❤ 3478 · https://www.instagram.com/p/C6VbLUXIZdA/

Sambar powder 🥘🍛
(Masala powder to make tasty Sambar)

Sambar, also known as Kuzhambu in TamilNadu, is a lentil-based vegetable stew, cooked with Toor Dal and tamarind broth.It is popular in South Indian and Sri Lankan cuisines. The stew has also been adapted into Burmese cuisine as a popular accompaniment to Burmese curries.

Sambar powder also known as sambar masala or sambar podi is an aromatic spice blend made with spices, lentils and herbs, and the main ingredient for making Sambar.

This powder can be ground in a machine and stopped for months in an airtight container.

Ingredients (~ 1.5kgs sambar powder)
- 1/2 kg dried red chillies
- 1/2 kg coriander seeds
- 50g peppercorns 
- 50g turmeric sticks 
- 100g toor dal
- 50g chana dal
- 50g urad dal
- 50g fenugreek 
- 1 tbsp cumin
- 1 tbsp mustard seeds
- 1 tbsp poppy seeds
.
.

HOME-MADE KITCHEN KING MASALA

Make your own Kitchen King Masala at home, just like the pros. It's easy, flavorful, and you control the ingredients!

 2 tsps fennel seeds

16-18 cloves

Pesara Punugulu also known as moong dal fritters is a popular street food in the Konaseema region and found across Andhra Pradesh streets. 

Typically, Punugulu is made with fermented batter but this one is quite a simple and less time-consuming recipe as it requires no fermentation and is made with freshly ground batter.

One batter for Idli and Dosai. No separate grinding too. Everything together in the blender. Can't get any easier.

No-Rice Ragi/Kezhvaragu Idli Dosai Batter. No Rice if you don't count Poha as rice (see comments)😁 Soak everything in one pot tonight and tomorrow night you can make Ragi Idli or Dosai 😊

Recipe
------------
Soaking:
🔸1½ cup Ragi/Kezhvaragu/Finger Millet
🔸½ cup whole Urad Dal
🔸½ cup Thin Poha (very important to use thin white Poha. I've tried others, but thin white Poha made the softest idlies)
🔸½ tsp Fenugreek seeds
---- wash and soak all of them together overnight 

Grinding:
Next day morning, transfer everything to a mixie jar, grind to a smooth batter. Transfer batter back to the container. Add water to adjust consistency (not too thick)

Fermentation:
Next step is fermenting the batter. Mix batter with hand for 3 mins continuously. Helps with the fermentation. Close the vessel with lid, but don't make it airtight. Let it slightly be open.

1. It's autumn here in Melbourne now. Around 20 to 24 deg C. I placed the batter in my oven with the lights on. It took 7 hours for the batter to ferment. Try to not over ferment the batter for soft and spongy idlies. So keep checking the batter after 7 hours for every 30mins or so.

## 1259. Jonna Ambali/ Fermented jowar malt😍
**@flavoursbymounika** · 2024-03-06 · video · ❤ 6953 · https://www.instagram.com/p/C4KedcLJZ6w/

Jonna Ambali/ Fermented jowar malt😍
Best probiotic summer drink which helps in weight loss👍

👉PREPARATION METHOD:
Step - 1 :
Mix 1/2 cup jowar flour with 2 cups of water without lumps.
Step - 2 
Boil - 3 cups of water. While water is rolling boiling add mixed jowar flour. Mix well and Cook until it thickens. It will thicken more gradually after cool down. 
Step - 3:
Transfer to a clay pot and cover it. Ferment for overnight or for 8 hours. 
Step - 4:
Make butter milk and add into fermented malt. 
Consume as it is with only salt or else top it with some chopped onions, green chilies, curry leaves, coriander leaves, cumin seeds.

## 1262. JOWAR PONGAL / JONNA PONGALI 😍
**@flavoursbymounika** · 2024-03-01 · video · ❤ 8247 · https://www.instagram.com/p/C39kca_J87l/

JOWAR PONGAL / JONNA PONGALI 😍

This jowar pongal work as a weight loss breakfast option with minimal efforts. Tastes extremely great and wholesome. Do try and save this recipe!

👉INGREDIENTS:
Jonna rava - 1 cup
Moong dal - 1/2 cup
Black pepper - 1 tbsp
Cumin seeds - 1 tbsp
Ghee - 2 tbsp
Cashews - 10
Green chillies - 2
Dry red chillies - 3
Curry leaves - 1 sprig
Ginger - 1 tbsp (chopped)
Asafoetida- a pinch
Turmeric powder - 1/2 tsp
Salt as per taste

PREPARATION METHOD:
Add moong dal and jowar rava into a pressure cooker, wash and add 4 cups of water, 1 tsp of black pepper, 1 tsp of cumin seeds, 1/2 tsp of turmeric powder, salt as per taste. Pressure cook upto 4 whistles on medium flame. Release the pressure and open the lid. Check the consistency and adjust it with hot water if required. For tempering, add ghee, mustard seeds, cumin seeds, cashews, crushed black pepper, chopped ginger, dry red chillies, green chillies (sliced), curry leaves and a pinch of asafoetida. Add into pongal and combine well. Serve hot.

## 1267. Sprouted Ragi Flour - Homemade 
**@yumcurry88** · 2024-02-19 · video · ❤ 144404 · https://www.instagram.com/p/C3hS6R_v_Bs/

Sprouted Ragi Flour - Homemade 

To make sprouted ragi flour at home, firstly wash 1 cup ragi 3-4 times in water until the water becomes clear. Now soak the ragi in enough water overnight.
Remove the water and transfer the ragi in a muslin cloth. Remove all the excess water by squeezing it. Keep this in a container and cover it.
Now leave this setup for 2 days and the ragi will be well sprouted. Keep on checking everyday if it’s too moist and catching any fungus.
Take it out once it’s sprouted well. Spread it in a plate and air dry it until it’s fully dry.
Roast it in a kadai to remove all the moisture and transfer it to a grinder and grind it to make a fine powder.
Store this ragi flour in an airtight container.

## 1271. Most favourite: Tomato Bath ❤️❤️.

Most favourite: Tomato Bath ❤️❤️. 
Can literally have this every single day and not get bored. It’s spicy, tangy and Goes best with Cucumber and onion raita 🤩. 
1. Wash and soak 1.5 cups Sona Masuri Rice for 30 mins. Boil 3/4 cup soya chunks for 5 mins and keep aside. 
2. Heat 4 tbsp oil in a cooker and add 2 bay leaf, 2 inch cinnamon, 1 star anise, 2 medium onion sliced. Cook until it softens and add 3 slit green chilli, 4 medium tomatoes, 1.5 tbsp ginger garlic paste, salt and cook till tomatoes soften. 
3. Add 2.5 tsp red chilli powder , 1 tsp Garam masala and cook till tomatoes turn completely mushy. Add boiled soya chunks, 1/2 cup green peas and mix well. 
4. Pour 2.5 cups water and mix. Add the soaked rice and mix. Let it come to a boil and then close the lid. Cook for 2 whistles on high flame. Once pressure releases naturally, rest for 30 mins and serve.

## 1273. Say Byeee👋 to store bought cereal and try this better & healthier chocolatey version right now 😍😎Made with only 5 ing
**@shivesh17** · 2024-01-30 · video · ❤ 122356 · https://www.instagram.com/p/C2uM7w_pa_P/

Say Byeee👋 to store bought cereal and try this better & healthier chocolatey version right now 😍😎Made with only 5 ingredients, this recipe makes for the perfect breakfast option that will instantly make you look forward to your morning meals all day, everyday☺️
Try it now and thank me later

Ingredients
🍫1/2 cup oats
🍫2 tbsp jaggery powder
🍫2 tbsp cocoa powder
🍫2 tbsp peanut butter
🍫3 tbsp milk

Method
1. Preheat the oven at 150 degrees celsius and line a tray with silicon mat.
2. In a mixer, add the oats and grind it into fine powder.
3. In a bowl, add the oats powder, jaggery powder, cocoa powder, peanut butter and milk.
4. ⁠Combine everything together and form a dough. Roll out small balls, line them on a tray and bake for 20-25 minutes at 150 degrees celsius.
5. Let them cool for sometime until its crunchy. Pour the milk and enjoy!
6. Also, you can double this recipe for making a bigger batch and store it in an airtight container for upto one month.

Murungai Keerai Sadam🌿
Ingredients:
Rice - 1 cup
Toor dal - 1/4 cup
Masaoor dal - 1 cup
Moringa leaves - 3 cups
Garlic - 10 cloves
Shallots - 1/2 cup
Tomatoes - 2 (large)
Curry leaves - 2 sprigs
Sambar powder - 2 tbsp
Salt as per taste
Oil - 3 tbsp
Water - as required 
👉Recipe process:
Wash dal and rice and soak for 30 minutes. In a pressure cooker, heat oil and add garlic and shallots. Fry for few seconds and add chopped tomatoes. Cook until soft and add salt, turmeric powder and sambar powder(I forgot to add turmeric powder in the video, later I added but the clip is missed). Add moringa leaves and saute for 2 minutes. Add soaked rice and dal. Add 5 cups of water and mix well. Cook upto 3 whistles. Open after the pressure is gone, add hot water to adjust the consistency if needed. 
For tempering, add 2 tbsp of ghee, 1/2 tsp of mustard seeds, 1/2 tsp urad dal, 1/2 tsp chana dal, a pinch of asafoetida, 1 sprig of curry leaves, 2 dry red chillies. Add into rice and mix well. Serve with papad and enjoy!

Do make it low flame otherwise ut gets burnt quickly , specially after adding cocoa !

Add ghee , jagerry and water 
Mix it well on low flame . Once mixture get bubbly . You can also do water test . Once you add jaggery mixture into water , it should turn hard . This should be done quickly . I add the cocoa powder and mix it well . Add makhana and roasted almonds .

Once warm
Or cold . Enjoy as it is or with cold milk

🥔 Accordion Potatoes

📝 Recipe

1-2 Potato
Water
1 tsp • Salt
1 tsp • Baking Soda 
Oil
Dried Parsley
Chili Sauce

Steps:

• Cutting the Potato
- Peel off the potato 
- Cut the ends of potato
- Cut the potato lengthwise / just like shown in my video, however you like and based on the size of the potato
- Take 2 skewers
- Put the potato horizontally and place the skewers on both sides of the potato
- Cut the potato in vertical lines
- Flip the potato
- Cut the potato again in diagonal lines

• Soaking; Accordion Potatoes
- Prepare water with salt and baking soda
- Soak the accordion potatoes in water for 5-10 minutes
- After soaking the potatoes, dry them with tissue / towel

• Cooking; Accordion Potatoes
- Heat the oil in pan at medium heat
- Fry the accordion potatoes until crispy and golden brown

• Finishing; Accordion Potatoes
- Serve the potato with dried parsley and chili sauce

Tips:

1. After cutting the potato into accordion shape, you will slice another ones. So keep the potato that have already been cut in water to prevent the potato turning into brown color.

## 1294. Calcium is Macro Mineral and  you have it the most of in your body. Almost 99% of calcium is found in hard tissues of bo
**@jonnas_kitchen** · 2023-11-22 · video · ❤ 1298 · https://www.instagram.com/p/Cz80RHevOiq/

Calcium is Macro Mineral and  you have it the most of in your body. Almost 99% of calcium is found in hard tissues of body like bones and Teeth and the rest is distrubed in blood and soft tissues.
Calcium has many roles in humand body and is particularly important during certain developmental stages mainly for growing childern, lactating Mothers, Pregnant mommies and elderly people
It is important for Bone formation, Tooth formation, growth,  blood clotting, cardiac function, muscle contraction, prevents preeclampsia during pregnancy, and helps in release of certain harmones
Not meeting your calcium dosage can inhibit growth of the child, can lead of osteroporosis, inadequate calicum ingestion can lead to hypocalcaemia and hypercalceaemia occurs in adults as a result of hyperparathyrodisim 
Women need to increase their calcium intake earlier in life than men, starting in middle age. Meeting the necessary calcium requirement is particularly important as a woman approaches menopause
If you miss your daily dose of calcium, you won’t become calcium deficient overnight instead it uses it from your bones and make you feel weak and leathargic But long-term low levels of calcium can have serious effects.Calcium deficiencies can affect all parts of the body, resulting in weak nails, slower hair growth, and fragile, thin skin

## 1300. If you really like corn 😉🌽, you might want to give this delicious recipe a try! And if you happen to have anything aga
**@thisbrownmom** · 2023-08-11 · video · ❤ 259319 · https://www.instagram.com/p/Cvzo20AtilX/

If you really like corn 😉🌽, you might want to give this delicious recipe a try! And if you happen to have anything against butter, you should look the other way🫣, but please don’t. This is yum 😋 

Buttery-Sweet, Smokey and Spicy. All the good things 😜

Here’s what you’ll need:
- 5 tbsp butter
- 500ml water
- 3-4 sweetcorn
- 1 tsp chilli powder
- 1 tsp smoked paprika
- 1 tsp garlic powder
- Juice of 1/2 a lime

Instructions:
1. Begin by melting 3 tbsp of butter in a pan along with the water and sweetcorn. Heat it on medium until it simmers, which should take around 15 minutes or until the water evaporates.

2. After this step, some butter will still be present in the pan. Lower the heat to medium-low and rotate the corn to ensure all sides are evenly fried. Be careful not to brown the corn, as the butter could burn. If you prefer more color, rather place it under the grill.

3. Before you’re ready to take the corn off the heat, add the remaining 2 tbsp of butter.

4. In a bowl, mix the juice from half a lime, along with the chilli powder, smoked paprika, and garlic powder. While the butter from the pan is still hot, pour it into the spice mixture. Then, drizzle this flavored butter over the corn.

And enjoy

## 1302. Postpartum hairfall is called Telogen effluvium – Temporary shedding of hair 
**@jonnas_kitchen** · 2023-07-20 · video · ❤ 3990 · https://www.instagram.com/p/Cu69cNlo9Z6/

Postpartum hairfall is called Telogen effluvium – Temporary shedding of hair 

Your hair normally grows in cycles (anagen(growing phase), catagenTransition phase) n  telogen(Shedding phase) But during pregnancy, most of the hair stays in the growth phase due to the big changes in your body’s hormones
Telogen effluvium (TE) is a diffuse hair pattern loss which occurs 3 months after a triggering event like giving birth to a baby and may be even due to stress, major surgery, an increase in androgen and estrogen hormones, hyperthyroidism and many others
PTE  usually Starts around 4 Months post delivery and settles down in 1 or 2 months and completely reduces by the baby reaches 1year of age 

Do mommies really have to worry ??? 
No, this is just temporary phase and happens due to switching of hormones and is completely normal
Can we do anything for it??
Yes, we always have to give a very good nutrition and continue your calcium n iron supplements as advised by your dctr 
With baby 2 I have extreme hairfall was not even able to touch it for almost 2 weeks and now it has controlled so much that I don't shed much ..
Here is the 1st thing that I did to control my hairfall 
1.	Curry leaf chutney /Including curry leafs in possible ways 
Curry leaves are rich in protective plant substances, such as alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds and this compounds function as Antioxidants   …
